jobs.title: Volunteer & Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Job Summary:**

The Volunteer and Program Coordinator will oversee all volunteer coordination and volunteer training activities at Chrysalis’ downtown Los Angeles office. Duties include onboarding, training, and coordinating all downtown volunteers and providing backup support in the case of volunteer absences. The Volunteer & Program Coordinator will provide direct services to Chrysalis clients, helping them build resumes, practice for job interviews, and will teach Chrysalis’ job readiness classes as needed.

**Duties and Responsibilities include but are not limited to:**

**Volunteer Recruitment, Coordination, Training, and Engagement**

* Maintain close communication with all DT volunteers and provide direct support on a daily basis, including addressing day-to-day emails, inquiries, and needs.
* Assess program needs, screen, onboard and train new volunteers regularly, and manage existing volunteers.
* Support and/or carry out volunteer appreciation and engagement activities, including recognizing volunteer milestones and helping to plan/execute regular volunteer engagement events.
* Evaluate volunteer performance on an ongoing basis, giving direct feedback, and following up with additional training as needed.
* Work closely with Client Services team, attending weekly staff meetings and maintaining active communication about volunteers and client training activities.
* Handle cross-functional communication and support across all Chrysalis sites, and support staff, clients, and volunteers.
* Take on special projects to help the Volunteer & Program team create and implement new processes and streamline program operations.

**Direct Client Service Delivery**

* Provide one-on-one resume preparation, practice interview services, and helping clients apply to jobs online, as well as facilitate job readiness classes as needed.

**Customer Service and Administration**

* Coordinate volunteer schedules to ensure full coverage of one-on-one and job readiness classes.
* Ensure up-to-date and complete tracking of volunteer activities in Chrysalis data systems.
* Communicate regularly with Development and Communications Department regarding relevant volunteer activity, including a quarterly call.
* Monitor and replenish supplies for all volunteer-related client services.

**Job Skills & Qualifications**

* Bilingual English/Spanish skills highly preferred.
* Highly motivated by Chrysalis’ mission and desire to improve social and economic  
  fabric of our community.
* Teaching/facilitation/training experience highly desired.
* Excellent interpersonal, communication and intercultural skills.
* Microsoft Word, typing and internet research proficiency required.
* Excel and PowerPoint proficiency desired.
* Strong organizational and time management skills.
* Prior experience achieving success working under limited supervision.
* Comfortable speaking to crowds and communicating with a wide variety of audiences.
* Ability and willingness to work occasional evenings and weekends.
* Reliable transportation travel to meetings and provide coverage support at other Chrysalis offices

**Physical Requirements:**

The physical requirements described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit, use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; and talk or hear. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, color vision, and ability to adjust focus. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds.

**FAIR CHANCE HIRING STATEMENT**

*Chrysalis is an equal opportunity employer and strongly encourages applications from all qualified individuals who share lived experience with the communities we serve. In particular, Chrysalis welcomes applicants who are formerly incarcerated and/or justice-involved; people who have experienced housing insecurity and/or economic inequity; Black, Indigenous, and people of color; persons with disabilities; ethnic and religious minorities; and members of the LGBTQ+ community.*

jobs.title: Graduate Program Coordinator, Mathematics, Philosophy, and Physics
jobs.description:
The Schmid College of Science and Technology (SCST) seeks a highly motivated individual to coordinate the graduate program in Math, Philosophy and Physics (MPP). SCST embodies Chapman’s mission of providing students with personalized educational experiences by fostering an outstanding community of teacher-scholars across a broad range of undergraduate and graduate programs. The MPP Doctor of Science program recruited the first cohort of students in Fall 2023. By working closely with the program director, leadership, and campus partners, the coordinator will provide administrative support and support a wide range of activities from recruitment through graduation, advising, outreach, orientation, and academic program support. The coordinator implements all activities to ensure enrollment goals are met, engages with students to support their success, and evaluates the continued success of the program. This role requires the individual to be a self-starter and proactive with the ability to coordinate and execute projects both on their own and within a team environment. This position will also collaborate with the existing graduate programs in Schmid College.

Responsibilities

**Recruitment, Admission and Registration Support**

* Serve as liaison to the Office of Graduate Admission, Graduate Financial Aid, Registrar, and Office of the Vice Provost for Graduate Education
* Provide administrative support for annual updates to MPP’s graduate handbook, materials, recruitment and admission
* Support recruitment efforts by proactively seeking out prospective students, track, and addressing all inquiries
* Track application materials and review for completeness, coordinate final reviews with the admissions committee, and communicate admission decisions in coordination with the Office of Graduate Admission
* Provide support for information sessions, conferences, and graduate fairs
* Track and maintain scholarships, tuition support and assistantships; prepare reports and apprise the director of the status
  

  

**Student and program support**

* Serve as a primary point of contact for current students, providing guidance on program policies, procedures, and requirements from admission through graduation; respond to student questions and concerns and refer to campus resources as appropriate
* Monitor student compliance with program requirements and track progression towards degree completion
* Collect data, summarize information, and prepare reports to support accreditation, assessment, program review, and updates to program requirements; monitor R2PC (recruit, retain, progress, complete) data and report to the Office of the Vice Provost for Graduate Education
* Prepare and maintain class schedules, textbook requirements, syllabi, part-time faculty contracts, catalog copy, and handbooks in collaboration with the Program Director
* Coordinate logistics for program events and activities such as orientation, seminars, guest speakers, receptions, and networking opportunities; prepare and process speaker agreements and related contracts
* Partner with the program director, leadership, and campus partners to identify student needs and establish support resources
* Participate and represent Schmid in university committees, programs, and events both on and off campus
* Orient new faculty and students to the program and university
* Coordinate maintenance of accurate student, alumni and faculty records including placement, degree progress, and demographic information
* Monitor program expenditures and provide financial reports to Program Director
* Prepare purchase orders and student expense reimbursements on behalf of the director, students and faculty; ensures compliance with university policy
* Coordinate various communications to students, faculty, Dean’s Office and Chapman community through multiple outlets including Canvas, web, email, print and verbal
  

  
Required Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution of higher education or equivalent combination of education and experience
* A minimum of two years related work experience in providing administrative, program coordination, or student support
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to work collaboratively with students, faculty, staff, and campus partners from different backgrounds
* Writing skills to prepare clear and concise, grammatically correct business correspondence; strong editing and proofreading skills.
* Strong technical skills to learn and use enterprise systems needed to track budget, maintain class schedules, process contracts, and admissions records
* Ability to maintain confidentiality of student records and applying federal and state FERPA and Information Privacy Act regulations
* Ability to prioritize work duties when faced with interruptions, distraction and fluctuating workload.
* Ability to exercise good judgment and accomplish tasks in a timely manner.
* Demonstrated organizational skills with the ability to prioritize multiple projects and maintain composure and good attitude when multi-tasking.
* Ability to schedule and coordinate logistics for meetings and events including coordinating catering, room reservations and set-up.
* Strong working knowledge in the MS Office Suite
* Ability to problem solve and find creative solutions in a fast-paced, student-centered environment

Desired Qualifications

* Experience working with graduate students in a university degree-oriented program, assessing progress toward a degree, and understanding and knowledge of academia
* Knowledge of graduate degree requirements to develop student academic plans and guide/track graduate students through academic planning
* Knowledge of higher education admissions criteria and ability to develop effective results-oriented recruitment strategies

Special Instructions to Applicants

At Chapman University, we believe collaboration thrives through in-person engagement. This position is fully on campus,

jobs.title: Social Media Content Creator & Brand Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Social Media Content Creator & Brand Coordinator**

**Location:** Manhattan Beach, CA, with scheduled shoots throughout South Bay and Los Angeles  
**Schedule:** Part-time, approximately 20 hours per week  
**Pay:** $20–$25 per hour, depending on experience and portfolio

**About the Opportunity**

AMICO Salon and MICO Haircare are looking for a creative, organized person to help tell the stories behind our salon and our developing haircare brand.

You’ll work directly with founder and hairstylists and collaborate with our branding and social media team. Your main focus will be filming, photography, short-form editing, and coordinating the people and locations needed to produce strong content for both brands.

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys beauty, hair, storytelling, and bringing creative ideas to life.

**What You’ll Do**

* Film and photograph hair transformations, styling tutorials, consultations, stylist interviews, product content, and behind-the-scenes moments.
* Capture founder journey and the process of building MICO Haircare.
* Edit short videos for Instagram Reels, TikTok, and other digital channels.
* Help recruit and schedule hair models, confirm shoot details, and coordinate participant permissions.
* Arrange shoots with stylists and participating salons, including locations outside AMICO.
* Research relevant beauty influencers and creators, conduct approved outreach, and track responses and follow-ups.
* Coordinate approved product gifting and creator content deadlines as programs develop.
* Follow creative briefs and shot lists while contributing fresh content ideas.
* Organize original footage, photos, and edited assets so our branding team can use them across social media, the website, and marketing campaigns.
* Provide light administrative support related to content production, scheduling, and brand coordination.

**How You’ll Work With Our Team**

Our branding and social media team will guide the creative direction and publishing calendar. You’ll help turn those plans into usable content through reliable coordination, filming, editing, and delivery.

**What We’re Looking For**

* Examples of short-form videos you personally filmed and edited.
* A strong eye for hair, beauty, lighting, composition, and visual storytelling.
* Confidence filming on a smartphone or camera and editing with CapCut, Premiere Pro, Final Cut, or similar tools.
* Familiarity with Instagram Reels and TikTok.
* Strong organization, communication, and follow-through.
* Comfort approaching models, stylists, salon owners, and creators professionally.
* Ability to work independently, take feedback, and meet deadlines.
* Based in South Bay or Los Angeles, with reliable transportation to scheduled work locations.

Beauty or salon experience, Canva skills, and experience coordinating shoots or creator partnerships are helpful. A strong portfolio and dependable work habits matter more than a specific degree.

**Work Schedule**

This role requires regular in-person work at our Manhattan Beach salon and scheduled location shoots. Weekly hours will include coordination, filming, travel between work locations, editing, and content organization.

**How to Apply**

Please submit:

* Your résumé or a brief summary of relevant experience.
* Three links to videos you personally filmed and edited, explaining your contribution.
* Your city and weekly availability.
* A short note about why you’d enjoy creating content for AMICO Salon and MICO Haircare.

Applications must include video examples to be considered.

Pay: $20.03 - $25.00 per hour

Expected hours: 20.0 per week

Work Location: In person

jobs.description:
**Purchasing Coordinator**

**Join Our Team:**

We are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive **Purchasing Coordinator** to join our growing team. This role is responsible for managing the purchasing process from order placement through fulfillment, building strong vendor relationships, negotiating competitive pricing, and ensuring timely delivery of products. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced environment, enjoys problem-solving, and excels at coordinating with suppliers, customers, and internal teams.

If you are highly organized, customer-focused, and enjoy working with vendors and sales teams to keep operations running smoothly, we'd love to hear from you.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Create, process, and manage purchase orders with suppliers, vendors, and manufacturers.
* Coordinate product procurement and fulfillment to ensure accurate and timely delivery.
* Negotiate pricing, terms, and delivery schedules with suppliers to maximize value and cost savings.
* Maintain strong relationships with vendors and manufacturers while monitoring supplier performance.
* Track and follow up on order status, shipments, backorders, and delivery schedules.
* Process and distribute purchase orders, invoices, and related purchasing documentation.
* Review and analyze purchasing reports and ad hoc data to support business decisions.
* Ensure customer requirements are accurately communicated and executed, including:
  + Product specifications and configurations
  + Quantity increases or decreases
  + Split shipments and multiple orders
  + Special customer requirements
  + Multiple shipping locations
* Serve as a liaison between suppliers, customers, sales teams, and internal departments regarding order status, updates, delays, and fulfillment issues.

* Strong customer service and relationship-building abilities.
* Exceptional attention to detail and organizational skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong problem-solving and follow-up skills.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.

* Experience in purchasing, procurement, order management, supply chain, inside sales support, or related roles.

* Experience negotiating pricing and managing vendor relationships.

**What You'll Bring:**

* A sense of urgency and ownership.
* Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills.
* A customer-first mindset.
* The ability to build productive relationships with suppliers and internal stakeholders.
* A commitment to accuracy, efficiency, and continuous improvement.

* Competitive salary
* Medical, dental, and vision coverage
* 401(k) plan

Join Air Fayre and help strengthen airline partnerships, service performance, and continuous improvement across our operation. We look forward to your application!

jobs.title: Men’s Social & Community Manager
jobs.description:
**About the Role**

  

The Men’s Social & Community Manager is the person who keeps Buck Mason's men's social channels running every day while standing up events to build community. You'll own the calendar and the posting, write the captions, answer the comments and DMs, run our creator program day to day, produce our events from guest list to teardown, and report back on what's working. The brand team sets the direction. You make it real on social and through our events.

  

It's an executional role with a high bar for taste for someone who’s product obsessed. Every caption, reply, creator pick, and guest list is a judgment call about what Buck Mason sounds and looks like, and we need someone who gets those calls right without a lot of back and forth. You'll work with the brand team and alongside Creative, Retail, Ecommerce, and Customer Experience.

  

### **What You'll Do**

**Social strategy and channel management**

* Own the men's social content calendar across all channels, aligned to product launches, campaigns, store openings, and seasonal moments.
* Help shape channel-by-channel strategy with the brand team: what each platform is for, what we post there, and how often. Then execute it.
* Publish daily, manage the queue, and keep every post on-brand in tone, typography, and image quality.
* Stay on top of platform changes and emerging formats, and propose tests worth running.

**Content and voice**

* Write captions, scripts, replies, and copy in the Buck Mason voice
* Partner with Creative on social-first photo and video, contributing to briefs and shot lists; capture content yourself when the moment calls for it.
* Build repeatable series and formats that give the men's feed a point of view.

**Community**

* Respond to comments and DMs daily in the brand voice, and route product and order issues to Customer Experience with context.
* Track sentiment, recurring questions, and product feedback, and share what you hear with Design, Retail, and Ecommerce weekly.

**Events**

* Produce Buck Mason's men's events end to end.
* Curate the invite list. Know who should be in the room, from loyal customers and local tastemakers to creators and press, and get them there.
* Build the vibe: concept, venue, music, food and drink, run of show, and the details that make it feel like us and not like a brand event.
* Own the logistics: budget, vendors, staffing, RSVPs, and day-of production, so everything goes off without a hitch.
* Capture it for social use in coordination with the Creative team and our event photographer.

**Partnerships and influencers**

* Source and manage day-to-day relationships with creators, stylists, and tastemakers whose audiences match ours: outreach, gifting, scheduling, and content review, with support from the brand team on contracts and budget.
* Coordinate with Paid Media on which organic content and creator assets should be amplified.

**Measurement**

* Own weekly social reporting: reach, engagement, follower growth, community health, and traffic attributed to social.
* Contribute to the monthly brand marketing readout with clear takeaways on what's working, and adjust the calendar accordingly.
* Work toward quarterly goals set with the brand team.

* 2–4 years running or supporting social and community for a consumer brand, ideally in menswear, lifestyle, or DTC retail.
* Examples of accounts you've worked on and content you've made, with results you can speak to.
* Excellent writing. You can land a caption in one line and a reply in a sentence, and you know when to say nothing.
* A sharp eye for photography, typography, and taste that fits a brand built on restraint.
* Fluency in Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and Pinterest, including native creation tools, and working knowledge of social management and listening platforms (e.g. Sprout, Later, Dash Hudson).
* Comfort with data: you can read a dashboard, pull a weekly report, and say in plain terms what the numbers mean.
* Some experience working with creators or influencer partnerships.
* Event experience. You've produced or coordinated brand events, you're calm on the day, and you sweat the details nobody notices until they're wrong.
* Organized and reliable. You can run a calendar, juggle a product launch and a store opening in the same week, and keep the account fed.
* A real interest in menswear: how clothes are made, how they fit, and the men who wear them. You know the difference between a Pima tee and a slub, and you have opinions on both.
* Experience in menswear: you understand the customer face to face.
* Basic photo and video editing skills (CapCut, Premiere, Lightroom).

### **Logistics**

* Reports to: VP of Digital
* Location: Buck Mason HQ, Los Angeles — onsite, 5 days/week

### **Benefits**

* We’ve got you covered – Buck Mason takes care of 80% of the monthly cost for employee-only plans. That 20% not covered gets deducted from your bi-weekly paycheck.
* Dependents – Buck Mason takes care of 50% of the monthly cost and 50% comes out of  
  your bi-weekly paycheck.
* We offer a wide range of PPO and HMO options through Anthem, with Vision and Dental plans  
  through Principal.  
  Plus, we’ve got HSA and FSA options to keep things flexible.
* 401k:  
  We’re all about planning for the future. Buck Mason matches 100% of your first 3% contribution,

Other Perks:

* Every month, you can ask us for a $50 wellness reimbursement. Use it for gym memberships,fitness classes, or mental health expenses – it’s up to you.
* Maternity Leave – 12 weeks of paid leave
* No probationary period to be eligible, State funds first (disability, Paid Family Leave, etc.) Buck Mason covers the remain

jobs.title: AI-First Administrative Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About Elite Open School**

Since 1987, Elite Education Group has trained generations of students and families worldwide to achieve their American education dreams. Elite Open School, founded in Southern California in 2015, provides accredited blended education for middle and high school students in the U.S. and abroad. EOS is accredited by both WASC and Cognia, offering UC-approved courses and College Board-approved APs.

**The Role: Why AI-First?**

This is not a traditional administrative role. We are looking for someone who sees every repetitive task as a problem to solve with AI. Your primary mission is to **reduce complexity, time, cost, and burden** across school operations by identifying, building, and maintaining AI-powered workflows and automations. You will be a part of the administrative foundation of our school and you will help us do it smarter, faster, and more efficiently than before.

We want you to figure out how to leverage the latest AI tools, integrations, and automations so that manual processes become automated pipelines, communication becomes streamlined, and our team can focus on what matters most: our students and their families.

**Core ResponsibilitiesAI Workflow Design & Automation**

* Audit existing administrative processes and identify opportunities for AI automation and augmentation
* Research, evaluate, and implement AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, Zapier, Make, Notion AI, Google AI features) to streamline school operations
* Build and maintain automated workflows for enrollment processing, student registration, data entry, withdrawals, and records management
* Design integrations between school systems (SIS, LMS, email, Slack, Google Workspace) to eliminate manual data transfer and reduce errors
* Create AI-assisted templates, auto-responses, and smart routing for common inquiries across email, Slack, and phone
* Document all automations and workflows so they are reproducible, trainable, and scalable

**School Administration (AI-Augmented)**

* Manage student information and data across school systems—using AI to flag inconsistencies, automate updates, and generate reports
* Handle Elite Open School communications—leveraging AI drafting, summarization, and prioritization tools
* Maintain thorough knowledge of EOS services and proactively surface relevant information to team members using AI-powered knowledge bases or internal chatbots
* Support team projects by responding to requests for assistance, using AI to accelerate research, document creation, and task coordination
* Oversee onboarding documentation and internal training materials—keeping them current and accessible, ideally through AI-generated or AI-updated resources
* Provide general administrative and clerical support, continuously seeking ways to automate or semi-automate recurring tasks

**Continuous Improvement & Reporting**

* Track time and cost savings generated by AI implementations and report on ROI to leadership
* Stay current on emerging AI tools, trends, and best practices relevant to education administration and edtech
* Proactively propose new automations and process improvements on a monthly basis
* Train team members on new AI tools and workflows as they are deployed

**Ideal Candidate ProfileMindset & Disposition**

* AI-curious and proactive—you experiment with new tools before being asked to
* Growth mindset with a bias toward action and iteration
* Comfort with ambiguity; you can figure things out without a playbook
* Patience, sincerity, and compassion in student- and family-facing interactions
* Genuine interest in growing within education and/or the edtech industry

**Skills & Capabilities**

* Demonstrated ability to use AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Copilot, or similar) for real work tasks—not just casual use
* Experience with or willingness to quickly learn workflow automation platforms (Zapier, Make/Integromat, Power Automate, or similar)
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Strong self-organization and attention to detail
* Ability to present oneself professionally and thrive in a fast-paced environment
* Familiarity with Google Workspace, Slack, and common SaaS tools
* Strong familiarity with administrative functions and server management in Discord

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or higher
* US work authorization required
* Portfolio, write-up, or demo of a workflow or process you’ve automated or improved using AI

**Career Foundations & Growth Tracks**

While this is an entry-level role, we place a strong emphasis on internal promotion and long-term growth. The ideal career progression moves from this role into supervising future AI-First Admin Coordinators, with potential advancement toward school leadership and school board governance positions. Elite works with each employee to ensure personal development, diverse experiences, and notable growth in the following areas:

* AI Operations & Process Engineering
* Management – Hiring, Training, Team Development
* Local or Regional Marketing
* Business or Brand Development – New Campus Startup or Established Campus Development
* Seminars and Public Speaking
* Public or International School Relations
* International Project Coordination
* Technology – AI Implementation, EdTech Development, Google Services, Systems Integration

**Compensation & Benefits**

* Full-Time: $35,000 – $45,000 annually
* Monthly Salary with Structured Bonuses
* Health Care
* Career Building Foundation
* Best Company Culture and Teamwork

**More About Elite Open School**

We aim to prepare students for the 4th Industrial Revolution. The acceleration in AI, robotics, biotech, and automation demands that we equip students with creativity, advanced communication, critical thinking, and cognitive flexibility. Elite Open School is uniquely “Open” to creativity-based education through multilingual campuses, digital and adaptive curriculum, individualized pacing, and unlimited experiential learning opportunities.

jobs.title: Marketing Operations Associate, Direct Marketing
jobs.description:
StubHub is on a mission to redefine the live event experience on a global scale. Whether someone is looking to attend their first event or their hundredth, we're here to delight them all the way from the moment they start looking for a ticket until they step through the gate. The same goes for our sellers. From fans selling a single ticket to the promoters of a worldwide stadium tour, we want StubHub to be the safest, most convenient way to offer a ticket to the millions of fans who browse our platform around the world.

From a team advancing to the playoffs to a major artist announcing a world tour, some of StubHub's most impactful marketing moments require quick decisions, sharp execution, and the ability to act at scale.

We're looking for a **Marketing Operations Associate** to help capitalize on these exciting moments and deliver timely, relevant email and push campaigns that drive fan engagement and business impact.

In this role, you'll own the planning, prioritization, and execution of high-impact event campaigns across sports, music, theater, and comedy. You'll determine which opportunities to act on leveraging insight tooling and coordinate campaigns from concept through launch, either independently or leading design and engineering teammates. You'll balance a planned marketing calendar with real-time opportunities, where speed and sound judgment can make a meaningful difference.

Beyond campaign execution, you'll help shape how our Direct Marketing team operates at scale. You'll identify opportunities to streamline workflows, improve campaign quality, and reduce manual effort, partnering with Product, Data, and Engineering to develop tools and automation that make our marketing more efficient and effective.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, brings strong operational judgment and attention to detail, and is excited to both execute great campaigns and build better ways of working. **Operational Excellence & Scale**

* Improve campaign workflows, templates, QA processes, and documentation to increase execution speed, consistency, and quality.
* Identify repetitive manual tasks and collaborate with Product, Data, and Engineering to develop existing and new scalable tooling and automation.
* Help transition the team to new processes and tooling. Gather feedback to improve solutions and ensure adoption.

**Measurement & Optimization**

* Monitor campaign performance and identify opportunities to improve targeting, creative, timing, and execution.
* Partner with the team to propose and execute experiments to improve campaign effectiveness and inform future strategy.

* Strong project management skills, with the ability to coordinate multiple campaigns, stakeholders, deadlines, and dependencies simultaneously.
* Exceptional attention to detail and operational rigor, particularly around campaign setup, quality assurance, and execution.

* Comfort navigating ambiguity, responding to time-sensitive opportunities, and balancing speed with quality.
* Clear communication skills and a collaborative approach to solving cross-functional challenges.
* A strong sense of ownership and bias for action; the ideal candidate is always seeking continuous improvement and measurable business impact.
* Comfort working with performance data and using metrics to inform decisions.

**Nice to Have:**

* Experience executing email, push, SMS, or other CRM campaigns.
* Background in consumer marketplaces, ecommerce, ticketing, entertainment, or other high-velocity consumer businesses.
* Familiarity with audience segmentation, personalization, A/B testing, and campaign performance measurement.
* Experience improving campaign workflows through automation, tooling, or process design.
* Working knowledge of SQL or analytics tools.

**Why this role matters:**

  

Direct marketing is one of StubHub's most powerful levers for reaching fans during high-intent moments. jobs.title: Producer / Production Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Great stories start with extraordinary people.**
==================================================

We’re bringing together exceptional creative talent to tell the stories of people shaping the future. Work alongside people who raise your standards, champion your ideas, and give you room to do the best work of your career.

*Story inspires science. Science makes story real.*

**Your Story**
--------------

We're looking for a Junior Producer / Production Coordinator who's organized, resourceful, and hungry to make great films.

Story produces high-end commercial and branded content for some of the world's most ambitious companies, alongside a growing slate of original scripted fiction and nonfiction projects.

You'll work directly with our producers and creative team to bring these productions to life. One day, you might be coordinating crew and logistics for a commercial shoot. The next, you're scouting locations, organizing equipment, or helping pull together a documentary production on a tight deadline.

We're looking for someone who takes initiative, figures things out, and doesn't wait to be told what to do. You're comfortable juggling a dozen moving pieces, solving problems on the fly, and doing whatever it takes to help a production succeed.

This is an opportunity to get hands-on experience across every stage of filmmaking, take on real responsibility, and grow into a producer capable of leading your own projects.

**What You'll Own**
-------------------

* **Keep productions moving.** Support multiple projects simultaneously, coordinating schedules, logistics, crew, equipment, locations, and travel.
* **Make things happen.** Research locations, source equipment, track down vendors, and find creative solutions to production challenges.
* **Coordinate crews and vendors.** Help book crew, manage communications, coordinate availability, and ensure everyone has the information they need.
* **Stay on top of the details.** Maintain production calendars, call sheets, contact lists, schedules, budgets, and other essential production documents.
* **Support shoots on set.** Help manage day-of logistics, coordinate with crew, and handle unexpected problems to keep productions running smoothly.
* **Track budgets and expenses.** Help prepare estimates, collect invoices, track spending, and keep production finances organized.
* **Support projects from start to finish.** Work with producers and the creative team throughout pre-production, filming, and post-production.
* **Take ownership.** Anticipate what needs to happen next, identify problems early, and take initiative to solve them without waiting for instructions.

**You're the Right Person If**
------------------------------

* You have some experience working in film, commercial production, documentaries, or a related creative production environment.
* You're extremely organized and can keep track of multiple projects, deadlines, and details at once.
* You're resourceful and persistent. When you hit a roadblock, you look for another way forward.
* You're proactive and take ownership of your work. You don't need constant direction to get things done.
* You're a clear communicator who can work confidently with crew, vendors, clients, and creative teams.
* You're comfortable with production tools, spreadsheets, budgets, calendars, and scheduling.
* You're adaptable and happy to jump between planning at a desk and solving problems on set.
* You have a genuine interest in filmmaking and want to understand every part of the production process.
* You're based in the SF Bay Area or willing to relocate.

**What Sets You Apart**
-----------------------

**You're relentlessly resourceful.** You don't give up when something gets difficult. You'll make the extra call, find another option, and keep pushing until you've figured it out.

**You're one step ahead.** You anticipate what needs to happen next and take care of details before anyone has to ask. You make the people around you more effective.

**You're organized under pressure.** You can juggle several projects, respond to last-minute changes, and keep everything moving without losing track of the details.

**You have a get-it-done attitude.** No task is beneath you. Whether it's building a production schedule, tracking down a location contact, or making a last-minute equipment run, you take pride in getting things done right.

**You want to become a great producer.** You're curious, ambitious, and excited to learn from experienced filmmakers. You don't just want to coordinate productions. You want to understand how they're built and lead them yourself.

jobs.title: Event Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About Us**
------------

Foundry Robotics is building an AI-native robotics manufacturing company focused on deploying advanced assembly and production capability for leading robotics companies and national-security-critical hardware. Basically, we're building robots that build robots.  
  
We are reimagining manufacturing through advanced robotics. Our mission is to rebuild the American manufacturing industry as an AI-first, assembly-focused, dual-use contract manufacturer. We aim to empower manufacturers with intelligent, efficient, and adaptable robotic systems that redefine productivity and quality. As a senior leader on our manufacturing team, you will have a direct and significant impact on our product, culture, and ultimate success. This role is 100% in-person at our office in Emeryville, CA.

**The Role**
------------

Our conferences and events are currently run by whoever has capacity. That has worked, and it has cost us: no one owns the calendar, no one owns the booth, and no one can say what any of it returned. This role takes all of it.

You will own the event program end to end — which shows we attend, what we bring, who we meet, and what came of it. You will run the logistics yourself, and you will be the person who can answer "was that show worth it?" with numbers rather than impressions.

This is a junior role with real surface area. When the event calendar is quiet, you will spend your time on social and content alongside our Social Media & Brand Voice Lead.

This is an on-site role in Emeryville. Events also mean travel flexibility.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* **Own the calendar.** Build and maintain the annual event plan — trade shows, conferences, customer dinners, recruiting events. Make the case for each one before we commit, not after.
* **Own the environment**. Plan and create the booth design, the giveaways and the experience visitors have and the impression they leave with of the Foundry brand, product and company.
* **Run the events.** Manage all aspects of the event from end to end and assign roles as needed (and available). Own the booth build and stocking, shipping and logistics, badges, hotels, travel, collateral, demo hardware, on-site setup and teardown. You are the one who knows where the crate is.
* **Own the numbers.** Define what a show is supposed to return before we go. Track spend, leads captured, meetings booked, pipeline influenced. Publish a readout within a week of every event, including the ones that did not work.
* **Run the follow-up.** Get leads out of the badge scanner and into the hands of the people who can act on them, with context, within 48 hours.
* **Prep the team.** Brief whoever is staffing the booth — talk track, target accounts, who to find, what to say. Make sure engineers who have never worked a show know what good looks like.
* **Support social and content.** Capture the shop floor and the show floor: photos, video, short posts. Draft and schedule content, and keep the content calendar honest.
* **Manage vendors and budget.** Contracts, deadlines, invoices, deposits. Keep the event budget current and flag overruns early.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

Founder mentality: We love people who build like it's their own company. You move fast, take ownership, and find a way through when the path isn't obvious. You have the drive to make big things happen and the judgment to take smart risks along the way. If you prefer a clearly defined lane, a predictable pace, and all the answers before you start, there's nothing wrong with that—but Foundry might not be the right fit.

* 1–3 years running events, field marketing. Conference, agency, hospitality, or ops backgrounds all count.
* Evidence you have shipped something physical to a deadline and had it arrive working.
* Comfort with a spreadsheet: budgets, lead counts, cost per meeting. You should want to know the number, not be handed it.
* Clear, quick writing. Booth copy, a one-pager, a follow-up email, a post.
* Willingness to travel and to work the long day that a show floor actually is.
* A bias toward doing it yourself. We are small; there is no events team behind you yet.

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* Experience at a hardware, robotics, manufacturing, or defense company.
* Having run a booth at a large industrial or defense trade show.
* CRM fluency (HubSpot, Salesforce) and lead routing.
* Photo, video, or social editing skills.

We care more about what you have run than where you ran it. If you have organized something ambitious outside of a job, tell us about it.

**Why Join Us?**
----------------

This is one of the only places where world-class manufacturing operators, mechanical engineers, robotics researchers, and software engineers sit in the same room — building production systems together.

We are committed to being deeply embedded in the U.S. industrial base. Our focus is simple: build adaptive robotic assembly systems that make American manufacturing scalable, resilient, and competitive again.

If you want to run a mature, well-defined commercial org, this may not be the role.

If you want to build the commercial engine that brings AI-driven manufacturing to every industrial and energy customer in America — this is it.

The base salary range for this full-time position in the location of Emeryville, CA is:

**$90,000—$150,000 USD**

The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for the position, determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, interview performance, and relevant education or training. Foundry Robotics employees in eligible roles are also granted equity based compensation, subject to Board of Director approval. You'll also receive benefits including, but not limited to: Comprehensive health

**ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.**

At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future.

We are seeking an experienced **Event Operations Lead** to lead the operational planning and delivery of complex, high-priority AMD events. This role will serve as the operational lead for assigned programs, translating established event strategy, audience requirements, and experience objectives into comprehensive operational plans and ensuring successful execution from early planning through onsite delivery and post-event closeout.

The successful candidate will operate with a high degree of autonomy, partnering closely with event portfolio owners, agencies, vendors, and functional teams to manage complex operational requirements, make informed scope and delivery tradeoffs, anticipate and mitigate risk, and deliver programs on time, within budget, and to AMD’s experience standards.

* Experience managing significant event budgets, forecasts, scopes, agencies, venues, and supplier relationships.

* Proven ability to lead complex cross-functional teams, agencies, and vendors without direct reporting authority.
* Strong risk-management, contingency-planning, and live-event decision-making experience.
* Ability to effectively influence and communicate with senior business and functional stakeholders.
* Strong financial management, judgment, communication, organization, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to provide guidance and mentorship to less experienced event professionals.

**EDUCATION**

* Bachelor's degree in event management, marketing, communications, business, or a related field is preferred.

**Are you a skilled professional who believes in lending your skills to end hunger during these unprecedented times? Join us to innovate for impact and reimagine the future of health and nutrition for patients and consumers.

The Key Account Manager (Hospital/Pharma) will be responsible for the Sales performance, protocol development and contracting within Key Accounts of the assigned geographic territory through successful execution of Marketing strategies. The role is responsible for developing business plans to grow business through building relationships with key decision makers and influencers including big hospital systems, clinics and specialty pharmacies.

The Key Account Manager will also be responsible for focused customer engagement and sales presentations to specific targets to support to expand the GI Pharma platform. This will be executed through carefully defined messaging strategy, call sequence, leveraging business and value solutions based on evidence and outcome data. This role will also work with appropriate IDN Hospital personnel in regards to transition of care and discharge protocols.

**Responsibilities:**  
  

* Account development and planning through identification of individual account business model and process, including key decision makers, influencers, and protocol; with focus on patient discharge and transition of care process.

• Demonstrated fluency in MS Office (Word/Excel/Outlook/PowerPoint) is required. • Must have excellent communication (oral and written), presentation, organizational and stakeholder management skills (including the ability to develop and maintain strong, cross-functional stakeholder relationships).  

* Willing and able to work under pressure to meet tight deadlines with minimal supervision.
* Must have current or prior strategic account planning, strong business acumen, as well as strong financial and analytical skills.
* Knowledge of value-based selling and experience with negotiating, clinical influence and account penetration/call planning is required.
* Must be able to work through change management and must be agile.
* Ability to meet or exceed Sales targets and to be data-driven is a must.

* Willing and able to travel at least 50% or more based on the needs of the team, territory clients or the business required.

**What You'll Be Doing**

jobs.description:
### **What is Verse?**

The race to AI has become the race to power. Every breakthrough in artificial intelligence depends on one thing: access to electricity. But across the country, aging grid infrastructure and years-long interconnection queues are slowing the deployment of the data centers that will power the next generation of innovation. Solving this challenge isn't just about energy it's about unlocking the future of AI.

At Verse, we're building the energy intelligence platform for the AI economy. Our software helps the world's largest energy consumers achieve faster, cheaper, and cleaner power by combining real-time control of energy assets with complete visibility into their energy portfolio. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners, GV, Coatue, and NVIDIA, and built by pioneers in grid-scale batteries, energy markets, and enterprise software, we're redefining how the world's most ambitious organizations access and manage energy.

### **The Role**

We're hiring a **Customer Success Manager** to own the relationship and commercial outcomes for a portfolio of enterprise energy buyers after they sign. This is a high-ownership, high-visibility role for someone who knows renewable energy procurement inside and out and can be a trusted advisor to sophisticated energy and sustainability teams from day one.

You'll join a lean, fast-moving Customer Success function and help shape how it operates as we scale. A key part of this role is growing with Verse into **dispatch intelligence and battery storage optimization** real-time products that will define the next chapter of the platform. You'll be the person who makes sure our customers adopt the platform, realize value, renew, and grow.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* **Own the relationship, adoption, and commercial outcomes** for a book of enterprise accounts from signature onward.
* **Drive** **revenue** **retention**lead renewals, protect gross retention, and identify and close in-footprint expansion.
* **Serve as a trusted energy advisor****,** guiding customers on PPA/VPPA portfolio management, invoice and settlement validation, generation forecasting, availability and production guarantees, and REC/EAC management.
* **Run executive business reviews**, build account health scoring, and manage senior stakeholder relationships up the org chart.
* **Translate the platform's analytical outputs**into clear business value and confident reporting for your customers.
* **Partner cross-****functionally**with Sales on closed-won transitions and expansion, with Delivery on onboarding and implementation quality, and with Product to channel voice-of-customer into the roadmap.
* **Be a driving force in Verse's move into real-time dispatch intelligence and battery storage optimization** a central part of this role as those products scale.
* **Own your metrics**revenue retention, renewal rate, customer health, and referenceable customers.

### **What We're Looking For (Minimum Qualifications)**

* **4+ years**in customer success, account management, or client-facing advisory/consulting — ideally in energy, cleantech, or enterprise SaaS.
* **Deep, working knowledge of renewable energy procurement:**PPAs/VPPAs, RECs/EACs, and wholesale power markets (e.g., ERCOT, PJM, MISO, SPP).
* **A track record**managing large enterprise relationships and owning retention and expansion outcomes.
* **Comfort with data and analytics** able to interrogate technical outputs and turn them into a business narrative.
* **Outstanding executive communication****,** and the instinct to ask the probing questions that surface what a customer actually needs.
* **A builder's mindset**comfortable operating with ambiguity in a startup, and willing to travel to customers (~20–30%).
* **Bonus:**exposure to real-time energy markets, dispatch optimization, battery storage, or energy trading; a background in energy advisory or asset management; or experience helping stand up a customer success function.

### **What Makes Verse a Great Place to Work?**

* Lead with Empathy: We lift each other up with humility and kindness, always putting colleagues and customers first
* Be Honest & Transparent: We prioritize effective communication to build trust with our team, customers, and stakeholders
* Move with Balance & Precision: We believe speed and perseverance must be accompanied by thoughtfulness and reflection
* Leave the World a Better Place: We are passionate about our mission, and we strive to create a sustainable world for future generations

### **Base Pay Range**

**$115,000 - $150,000**

This is the estimated base salary range for this position, which does not include the value of benefits or a potential equity grant. A wide range of factors are considered in making compensation decisions, including but not limited to level, skill sets, market conditions, experience and training, licensure and certifications, and business and organizational needs.

### **Benefits and Employee Perks**

* Comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental and vision insurance, and 401k

* Diverse and inclusive working environment

Landing is a nationwide hospitality platform where fully furnished apartments meet hotel quality and consistency. Guests book from thousands of apartments in hundreds of cities, for a week or a year, all backed by 24/7 local support. We're headquartered in Birmingham, and this role sits in our San Francisco office.

**Who We Work With:**

Our partners are apartment owners and property operators. Through **Autopilot**, Landing's owner partnership program, we turn their units into furnished, hospitality-grade homes and fill them with our nationwide demand. Owners see new revenue and higher occupancy in weeks, and we handle everything from furnishings to guest turnover with zero operational lift on their end.

**About the Role:**

As a **Business Development Representative**, you'll be the first conversation an owner has with Landing. You'll find ownership groups and operators across the country, get them on the phone, and show them what Autopilot can do for their buildings. Our Account Executives handle the close, so your job is opening the door and getting owners to the table. Owners actually want what we offer, so your calls turn into real conversations. Every unit your pipeline brings in grows Landing's supply, and you get paid on it with no cap.

**What a Week Looks Like:**

* At least 80 touches across calls, email, and LinkedIn, using Landing-approved messaging and cadence

jobs.description:
**Description**
---------------

The Willis RFP team is seeking a highly motivated Project Coordinator to support the development of request for proposal responses, presentation pitches, and competitive engagement deliverables. In addition, the Project Coordinator will partner closely with the RFP Team Leader and RFP Operations Leader on strategic and operational projects. The work is highly collaborative and will involve engagement with internal client stakeholders such as client managers, subject matter experts, brokers and internal teams across growth operations, marketing, compliance, and design.

Note: Employment-based non-immigrant visa sponsorship and/or assistance is not offered for this specific job opportunity.

**The Role**

Working within the RFP team is fast-paced and deadline-driven, often involving multiple projects at once. You’ll gain exposure to a wide range of industries and business initiatives, while building foundational skills in strategic communication, project coordination, and business writing. This role offers a unique opportunity to learn how Willis positions itself in competitive markets and contributes meaningfully to growth and client retention. Collaboration and adaptability are key, as you’ll work closely with diverse teams to deliver high-quality proposals that reflect Willis’ commitment to excellence. This depth of experience, combined with access to a broad internal network, creates meaningful career‑pathing opportunities across strategic growth areas such as Risk & Analytics and Cyber, as well as Growth and Client Management, Marketing and Communications, and Broking and Placement.

Responsibilities:

* In partnership with the assigned Project Manager, supports the proposal development process and timelines, including kick-off meetings, content planning, role assignments, proposal outlines, proofreading and rehearsal prep.
* Supports the creation of strategic and competitive RFPs and pitches by aligning responses to client/prospect needs and industry demands.
* Helps with editing executive summaries and other copy for pitches and proposals as determined by the Project Manager or the leadership team.
* Supports the creation of new material based on Willis’ business initiatives, value proposition and client/prospect requests.
* Assists in proofing final drafts of RFPs/pitches, executive summaries and team biographies before submission to the client/prospect, ensuring WTW guidelines and standards are met/exceeded.
* Helps provide company and industry research in connection with the client/prospect participating in the RFP/pitch process to help with content strategy and customization.
* Ensures accurate and timely responses to requests from other corporate services (e.g., Compliance, Technology, Supplier Diversity).
* Helps with maintenance of the team’s content repositories and utilizes these databases to support the proposal process, leveraging templates and content for efficiency and consistency.
* Provides support for strategic and operational initiatives being introduced by the EDGE team leadership.

**Qualifications**
------------------

**The Requirements**

Education and Qualifications:

* Bachelor’s degree preferred in Communications, Marketing, Business, Finance, Liberal Arts, Sociology, Law, or a related field.
* 2–4 years of relevant experience.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, with intermediate to advanced Excel skills.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, organizational, and planning skills, with excellent attention to detail.
* Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills.
* Demonstrated ability to engage effectively with stakeholders, work independently, and manage competing priorities.

  

Competencies:

* Strong interpersonal and customer service skills.
* Effective time management, prioritization, and project management capabilities.
* Sound judgment and a commitment to continuous learning and professional growth.
* Demonstrated proficiency in using approved AI-enabled and digital tools to enhance productivity, workflow efficiency, knowledge sharing, and client outcomes.
* Ability to evaluate AI-generated outputs for accuracy, relevance, compliance, and business impact.
* Understanding of Responsible AI principles, including data privacy and information security.

  

This position will remain posted for a minimum of three business days from the date posted or until sufficient/appropriate candidate slate has been identified.

Base salary range and benefits information for this position are being included in accordance with requirements of various state/local pay transparency legislation. Please note that base salaries may vary for different individuals in the same role based on several factors, including but not limited to location of the role, individual competencies, education/professional certifications, qualifications/experience, performance in the role and potential for revenue generation.

The base salary compensation range being offered for this role is $55,000 - $85,000 USD per year.

This role is also eligible for an annual short-term incentive bonus.

**Job Description**
-------------------

The Transportation Planning and Management Division (TPM) is responsible for the safe, efficient, and environmentally responsible movement of people and goods on the City's streets, supporting the larger goals of economic and social vitality for people living, working, and doing business in New York City. The Division’s responsibilities include planning, street design, technical analysis, signs, transit development, freight mobility and markings, and ensuring the safety of motor vehicle occupants, pedestrians, and cyclists.
  
  
Research, Implementation, and Safety unit (RIS) is a multi-disciplinary team dedicated to making the streets of New York City safer for all users as part of Vision Zero, a citywide policy striving to eliminate serious injuries and fatalities from traffic crashes. School Safety, a unit within RIS, is responsible for improving safety near K-12 schools throughout New York City. The group redesigns streets next to schools with a goal of reducing child injuries, improving safety and accessibility, and encouraging non-motorized transportation in all five boroughs. School Safety advises NYC agencies and private parties on school siting and various policy and street design issues related to youth safety and school operations. The unit manages all curb regulations and signage next to NYC K-12 schools, including the School Slow Zone program.
  
  
Under the direction of senior staff and with wide latitude for independent judgment, the candidate will be responsible for planning, developing, designing, and implementing Street Improvement Projects (SIPs) to improve safety for all roadway users with a particular emphasis on child safety, in order to advance the goals of the NYC Streets Plan and the Vision Zero Action Plan. This role will involve project management, extensive community outreach, research, data analysis, implementation coordination, and field work.  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
The selected candidate will analyze crash and traffic data; create street designs using AutoCAD; coordinate with staff throughout DOT and partner city agencies; perform extensive community outreach to schools, elected officials, Community Boards, inter-and intra-agency members, and other stakeholders; develop and deliver public presentations; and manage implementation of new roadway designs. Outreach work with students in NYC schools may be required on some of the projects. Additionally, the candidate will have the opportunity to investigate new design treatments and policy initiatives, to develop and pilot innovative safety treatments, and to develop new capital projects for implementation by the Department of Design and Construction on behalf of NYC DOT School Safety. The candidate will also coordinate research efforts; participate in technical and advisory committee meetings; and work with DOT staff and external agency representatives on studies and projects.
  
  
Additional tasks may include reviewing community requests as related to school safety and operations in NYC. Furthermore, the candidate will help the team deliver on the ambitious goal of Mayor Mamdani’s administration to install a 15-mile-per-hour school slow zone next to every K-12 school in NYC by the end of 2029 and assist with planning and coordination tasks associated with the School Slow Zone program.
  
  
The Department of Transportation's (DOT) mission is to provide for the safe, efficient, and environmentally responsible movement of people and goods in the City of New York and to maintain and enhance the transportation infrastructure crucial to the economic vitality and quality of life of our primary customers, City residents.
  
  
In order to be considered for this position candidate must be serving permanently in the title, or reachable on the civil service list.

**Minimum Qualifications**
--------------------------

  
  

1. A master's degree in transportation engineering, mathematics, urban planning, architecture, landscape architecture, urban studies, or related physical and social science fields; or
  
  
2. A baccalaureate degree in engineering from an accredited college and one year of full-time satisfactory experience performing technical work on roadway transportation and traffic studies and area-wide traffic programs; or

jobs.description:
The Workplace Experience Program Specialist owns employee events, programs, and experience initiatives end-to-end, from initial brief and stakeholder alignment through planning, production, and post-initiative review, and serves as the primary workplace experience partner to our senior leaders. This role is New York, USA-based.

The Specialist operates independently across a varied portfolio of concurrent work, managing vendors, cross-functional partners, and budgets. Success requires the ability to move fluidly between strategic advisory and hands-on delivery shaping the brief with a department head one day, managing a venue walkthrough the next.

**Key Responsibilities**

Event Planning & Delivery

Own assigned events from end-to-end, from brief through delivery and post-event wrap. The scope, scale, and complexity of what is owned increases with seniority, as does the degree of independent judgement expected at each stage.

* Own end-to-end delivery of employee events, programs, and experience initiatives across the US
* Build project plans, run-of-show documents, and risk plans for complex or large-scale events
* Manage vendor sourcing, negotiations, contracts, and on-site relationships
* Oversee full budget management: forecasting, reconciliation, and reporting
* Coordinate cross-functional support (facilities, IT, People team, etc.) to ensure seamless execution
* Ensure legal and compliance requirements are met across all event-related procurement

Stakeholder Partnership

* Serve as the primary workplace experience partner to department heads and People leadership in the US
* Lead stakeholder briefings and alignment sessions; translate business intent into experience design
* Advise on event strategy: help leadership determine the right format, investment level, and experience goals
* Manage expectations proactively; navigate competing priorities and tight timelines with clarity

Standards & Process

* Apply and uphold our event and experience execution standards; adapt frameworks for the US market context
* Contribute to the development and refinement of global event standards, playbooks, and the service catalog
* Introduce new event formats and experience approaches that raise the bar for employee programming
* Maintain accurate records: post-event documentation, budget actuals, attendance data, and learnings

Data & Continuous Improvement

* Own the US events measurement approach: collect, analyze, and report on experience quality and employee sentiment
* Produce post-event reports and strategic write-ups; link outcomes to broader employee experience goals
* Analyze trends across the US event portfolio to inform future program investment and priorities

Collaboration & Teamwork

* Work closely with the global Workplace Experience team to align the US event portfolio with broader workplace experience strategy
* Partner with the Experience Design team on integrated experiences where events connect to broader business outcomes
* Represent the Workplace Experience function in US-based cross-functional planning forums

**What We're Looking For**

Genuine passion for employee experience, the ability to operate independently across a varied and concurrent portfolio, and the credibility to partner with senior leaders on experience strategy.

* At least 4-6 years of experience, including ownership of large-scale events or employee experience programs
* Proven track record delivering events and programs from concept through completion- on time, on brand, and on budget
* Strategic thinker who can move between vision and execution without losing either
* Strong stakeholder manager: shapes briefs, manages expectations at leadership level, and advocates for the employee experience
* Comfortable developing playbooks, processes, and standards- both for their own work and as contributions to the broader global team
* Deep knowledge of event production: vendor markets, technical production, and logistics
* Self-directed and adaptable; comfortable owning the full delivery chain independently

*There are a variety of factors that go into determining a salary range, including but not limited to external market benchmark data, geographic location, and years of experience sought/required. In addition to a competitive base salary, roles are eligible to be considered for an annual bonus and equity grant.*

*The range for the NYC-metro area is: $110,291 - $122,545*

**E-Verify Program Participant**

We are an E-Verify employer – meaning that your Form I-9 information will be provided to the federal government to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S.

For more information, please view: E-Verify Participation Poster (English/Spanish) and IER Right to Work Poster (English/Spanish)

jobs.title: Programs & Community Coordinator
jobs.description:
Want to make cancer suck less and actually enjoy doing it? Stupid Cancer is looking to fill the open role of Programs and Community Coordinator with someone who is organized, outgoing, and wildly efficient to join our small but mighty team.

Reporting to the Program Manager, you will tackle a dynamic mix of programmatic, administrative, and community-facing initiatives. If you are a collaborative problem-solver with stellar communication skills and a passion for making programs run like clockwork, we want you on our team.

Stupid Cancer is the leader in adolescent and young adult (AYA ages 15 - 39) cancer support, education, and advocacy. Since 2007, Stupid Cancer has provided a lifeline of support, community, and resources of the AYA cancer community. Our vision is that everyone affected by AYA cancer can Get Busy Living.

The Stupid Cancer team reports to our New York City headquarters at least 2 days a week. Therefore, only candidates in the NYC area will be considered.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Community Engagement & Support**

* Develop and strengthen strong relationships with community members and nonprofit partners to foster continued growth in program participation.
* Support the planning and implementation of Stupid Cancer's core programs including, but not limited to, Meetups, Stupid Cancer Stories, and CancerCon.
* Recruit, train, and support in the management of program participants and volunteers across various initiatives, including Meetup Hosts, to facilitate impactful community spaces.
* Serve as a primary point of contact for all community member inquiries.
* Represent Stupid Cancer professionally at virtual and in-person programs including CancerCon, industry conferences, and networking events as needed (includes occasional evening and weekend commitments).

**Administrative & Operational Ef**fi**ciencies**

* Provide comprehensive administrative and operational support across all Stupid Cancer programs and events.
* Build, manage, and track all programmatic events within Cvent (the organization’s event management and registration platform) and Neon (the organization’s CRM) to ensure seamless cross-departmental coordination.
* Maintain and systematically update the organizational program calendar, ensuring all events are accurately published on the Stupid Cancer Calendar of Events webpage in a timely manner.

**Communications Support**

* Partner closely with the Communications Manager to support the drafting of programmatic email marketing, social media campaign content, website updates, and overall digital/printed asset creation, with training provided on specific platforms as necessary.
* Monitor the organization's social media channels, engaging authentically with followers to foster a vibrant online community.

**Other Duties**

* Fulfill additional duties and special projects as assigned.
* Actively collaborate across all departments to ensure alignment on projects and initiatives.
* Occasional program implementation on evenings and weekends.

QUALIFICATIONS & SKILLS

* Four-year college degree (or equivalent combination of education and experience).
* Excellent communication and customer service skills (email, phone, and face-to-face).
* Strong organizational skills with a keen eye for detail.
* Ability to juggle multiple priorities simultaneously and take initiative on new tasks.
* Prior experience building relationships with diverse groups of people and managing volunteers.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, Google Suite, and standard social media channels.
* Legally eligible to work in the United States; no sponsorship provided.
* Two years of related professional experience preferred.
* Experience with WordPress and Mail Chimp preferred.
* Experience with Canva Preferred.
* Familiarity with the AYA Cancer community preferred.

The salary range for this full-time, non-exempt position is $45,000 - $50,000. Eligible to participate in Stupid Cancer’s comprehensive benefits program including Medical, Dental, Life and Disability Insurance, a 401K matching Plan, and more.

jobs.description:
**Overview**

What began in 2017 as an idea on the back of a napkin has quickly become an award-winning, fastest-growing communications firm working with some big-name consumer and B2B technology brands. At SourceCode, we’re focused on bringing brains and hustle, humanity and technology, creativity and business intelligence back to public relations.

SourceCode’s Account Coordinators are not expected to remain on the sidelines of an account and are encouraged to be active, curious, and collaborative members of the team. We’re looking for a motivated professional with 0–1 years of PR experience (or strong internship background) to become a valued teammate and foundational support for our clients. We want our Account Coordinators to take on real responsibilities and embrace opportunities that help them grow rapidly as professionals. Opportunity here is earned, initiative is rewarded, and success is celebrated across the wider team.

**What You’ll Do:**

* **Draft Client Materials:** Write press releases, media pitches, and client reports, collaborating with senior team members to refine and polish content.
* **Build Media Networks**: Conduct research to build targeted media lists using tools like Muck Rack, support daily outreach, and pitch stories with a goal of converting opportunities 60%–70% of the time.
* **Monitor Coverage & Trends**: Track media coverage and analyze Muck Rack data to identify industry themes and trends for regular client reports.
* **Client Communication**: Liaise with client contacts over Slack, email, and status calls to deliver updates and draft client messages with minimal edits.
* **News Monitoring**: Read and share relevant daily news that connects to client priorities, helping to identify and lead rapid-response media opportunities.
* **Campaign Tracking**: Monitor speaker opportunities, awards, event calendars, and seasonal editorial calendars to maximize client success.
* **Influencer & Social Support**: Research and identify targeted influencers and assist with social calendar management and content creation.
* **Account Logistics**: Deliver accurate meeting agendas, action items, call reports, and recap emails to team leads for review.
* **Project Management**: Coordinate and track account workflows across teams to ensure timely delivery of services.
* **Active Brainstorming**: Bring creative thinking and vocal contributions to internal and client brainstorming and planning sessions.
* **Goal Alignment**: Maintain awareness of client goals and KPIs, proactively alerting team members with recommendations if tasks fall behind schedule.
* **Operational Excellence**: Learn agency processes, maintain accurate time-tracking, and support business health by understanding the impact of under/over-servicing clients.
* **Business Development**: Support agency growth by participating and taking an active role in business development.
* **Skill Growth**: Actively develop your writing skills, stay current on industry trends, and participate in professional development sessions per quarter.

**Hybrid (NYC-based)**

Designed to balance focused remote work with the collaborative energy of our headquarters located conveniently near Penn Station.

* In-Office: Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday
* Remote: Monday, Friday

**Salary Range**: $50,000 - $55,000

 **Requirements**

**What You Have:**

* **Agency & PR Fundamentals**: A foundational understanding of how PR agencies operate and a basic familiarity with core industry tools (e.g., Muck Rack).
* **Media & Relationship Savvy**: A strong appreciation for how the media operates, with a demonstrable background in building smart media lists and pitching journalists, influencers, or analysts.
* **Strong Writing & Research Skills**: Ability to research a business or industry and compose a thoughtful, well-crafted position on a relevant topic.
* **Fast-Paced Project Management**: Exceptional organizational and time-management skills, with a meticulous attention to detail and the ability to handle multiple priorities without sacrificing quality.
* **Workload & Boundary Management**: The confidence to clearly communicate your workload to team members, proactively managing and resetting expectations across multiple deadlines when necessary.
* **Creative Problem-Solving**: Curiosity to ask the right questions, a willingness to figure things out, and a passion for pushing beyond "one-size-fits-all" strategies to try new things.
* **Start-Up Mindset:** An ambitious, adaptable, and hard-working attitude with the ability to think on your feet, meet strict deadlines, and actively contribute to a growing team's success.
* **Clear Communication**: Ability to articulate ideas succinctly and draft written materials with a high degree of accuracy.
* **Location**: Currently based in the NYC area, or fully prepared to relocate to NYC by your official start date.

  
**Benefits**

**What We Offer:**

* Robust benefits program
* Unlimited vacation with PTO minimums
* Unlimited sick time
* 401k with company match
* Monthly wellness and mobile stipends
* 2 ‘NOPE’ days/year
* Profit-sharing program
* Workplace flexibility
* Professional learning and development allotment
* 6-month paid parental leave
* Transit benefits
* Paid volunteer and professional development days

jobs.description:
**About Wunderkind:**

Wunderkind ads are 'behaviorally triggered', meaning that ads are served on a premium list of publishers only when a user is done consuming content. Our proprietary tag is integrated directly on the publisher page to track on-site user behavior - making '**net new'** ad placements. *How* we serve the ad is why we are different from our competitors in-market.

Rather than placing an ad in front of someone while they're actively trying to read content, our technology patiently waits until a visitor has stopped reading before rendering our ad on the page. And that patience pays off - it turns out that when an ad experience respects the user's reason for visiting a page, the user respects the ad experience in return. This unique, brand safe approach to ad experience gives an advertiser's message more attention and greater engagement.

**About the Role:**

Here at Wunderkind, we have an innovative and truly differentiated enterprise product that fundamentally changes how publishers monetize their websites and you can play a key part in leading that shift.

Wunderkind Ads is looking for a top-performing Account Manager to work with our existing business team to retain and expand agency, trading desk, brand and DSP accounts across the midwest region. We are looking for someone with a proven track record of driving retention and building healthy client relationships. You will be given tremendous responsibility early on, immediately start to build a network of relationships from leading agencies, and have the chance to directly contribute to the explosive growth of Wunderkind as a key player in the market.
