jobs.title: Account Manager, Startups
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Trusted by more startups around the world, AWS makes the power of cloud computing accessible for all by giving founders everywhere access to the same technology that powers the world’s largest companies. With nearly 20 years of experience gained from supporting hundreds of thousands of startups that have come before, we help founders prove that their world-changing ideas are possible, at any stage of growth or level of funding. This is why more startups, and over 80% of unicorns, build on AWS.  
  
As AWS continues to rapidly grow, we seek a Startup Account Manager to earn trust and help drive growth amongst a set of well-funded, high-potential startups.
  
  
Startups represent a critically important subset of customers to AWS. These companies have unique needs, technical considerations, sales cycles, and growth trajectories that distinguish them from traditional companies. These businesses require different engagement strategies and sales motions from sellers to effectively acquire, grow, and retain them on the AWS platform long-term.
  
  
The ideal candidate possesses strong sales acumen, knowledge of the startup ecosystem, and a passion for (and familiarity with) AI/ML. You will be working with startups building innovative solutions, so extensive collaboration with both external and internal teams will be key to build and execute on plans to meet and exceed sales quota. Your responsibilities will include driving revenue, accelerating innovation through service adoption, and ensuring these startups select AWS as their primary cloud provider. You will work closely with product and service teams, business development, marketing, solution architecture and partner teams to drive customer outcomes.
  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Ensure customer success with early and mid stage startups
* Drive revenue and market share in a defined territory or industry vertical
* Accelerate customer adoption through well-developed sales engagements and successful GTM Strategy
* Meet or exceed quarterly revenue and goal targets.
* Develop and execute against a comprehensive account/territory plan.
* Create & articulate compelling value propositions around AWS services.
* Accelerate customer adoption by engaging Founders, CxO, Board of Directors and VC influencers
* Work with partners to extend reach & drive adoption.
* Develop long-term strategic relationships with key accounts.
* Expect moderate travel.

  
About the team  
Diverse Experiences  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  
  
Why AWS  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  
  
Work/Life Balance  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.  
  
Inclusive Team Culture  
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.  
  
Mentorship and Career Growth  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5+ years of full sales cycle, technology sales or equivalent business development, sales engineering/consulting or equivalent experience
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience with sales CRM tools such as Salesforce or similar software
* Experience (technical or educational) in Engineering or Computer Science
* Experience driving new business in greenfield accounts at the C-suite level or equivalent

  
Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.  
  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

The base salary range for this position is listed below. Your Amazon package will include sign-on payments, restricted stock units (RSUs), and sales incentives. Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Account Management at Uber means navigating ambiguity, earning trust fast, and solving problems that don’t come with a script. jobs.description:
The International Rescue Committee (IRC) responds to the world's worst humanitarian crises, helping to restore health, safety, education, economic wellbeing, and power to people devastated by conflict and disaster. Founded in 1933 at the call of Albert Einstein, the IRC is one of the world's largest international humanitarian non-governmental organizations (INGO), at work in more than 40 countries and 29 U.S. cities helping people to survive, reclaim control of their future and strengthen their communities. A force for humanity, IRC employees deliver lasting impact by restoring safety, dignity and hope to millions. **This position is open to candidates with existing work authorization in the location where the position is advertised.**

* Familiarity with digital marketing channels and campaign workflows
* Comfort working with web platforms, CMS tools, and basic technical concepts
* Strong communication and problem-solving skills

**Desirable:**

* Experience with project management tools (Monday.com, Jira, etc.)

jobs.title: Executive Assistant
jobs.description:
Executive Assistant
===================

**Location**

1 Smith Street, Brooklyn, NY 11201 (on-site five days per week)

**Reports To**

Executive Director & Chief of Staff

**About The HOPE Program**

The HOPE Program (HOPE) empowers New Yorkers to build stronger futures through comprehensive training, employment, career advancement, and lifelong support. For forty years, HOPE has stood as a pillar for individuals facing systemic barriers to economic opportunity.

Our vision of a Home Of Prosperity and Empowerment goes beyond traditional job placement. We prepare participants for meaningful, sustainable careers while working to address systemic challenges in underserved neighborhoods. Through our signature workforce development initiatives and holistic support services, we empower individuals to overcome unemployment, underemployment, and financial instability — creating lasting change for themselves and their communities.

Our employees embody HOPE’s core values—Heart, Opportunity, Purpose-Driven, and Excellence—by embracing a growth mindset, showing empathy, and remaining deeply committed to the individuals we serve. We are committed to breaking the cycles of poverty and exclusion that impact so many in our city.

**Position Summary**

The Executive Assistant is a trusted partner to the Executive Director and senior leadership team. The role keeps leadership organized and moving: managing the Executive Director's calendar and correspondence, preparing for meetings, tracking follow-ups, and supporting board and funder engagement. The Executive Assistant is also a welcoming first point of contact for HOPE: greeting all stakeholders who visit our main site, connecting them to the right people, and managing the main phone line and mail. The Executive Assistant notices what needs to happen, connects the Executive Director's office with teams across HOPE, and takes initiative without waiting to be asked. The role reports to the Executive Director and the Chief of Staff and works closely with the senior leadership team. This is a great opportunity for a motivated recent college graduate who wants to grow in nonprofit leadership, and a strong fit for someone with proven executive or administrative support experience.

**Key Responsibilities**

#### **Executive Director Support**

* Manage the Executive Director's calendar, scheduling, and meeting coordination, balancing priorities and protecting time for strategic work.
* Manage the Executive Director's correspondence: sort her inbox and mail, flag urgent items, draft replies, letters, and thank-you notes, and follow each item through to completion.
* Prepare the Executive Director for each day and week with agendas, briefing notes, and background materials.
* Coordinate the Executive Director's external meetings, events, and travel.
* Collect and submit the Executive Director's receipts and expense reports on time.

#### **Senior Leadership Team Support**

* Schedule senior leadership team meetings, prepare agendas, take notes, and track decisions and action items.
* Follow up with leaders on deadlines and action items, and remind owners before items slip.
* Create and maintain trackers, shared calendars, and records for leadership priorities.
* Support senior leaders with scheduling, document preparation, and special projects as needed.

#### **Executive Office Operations**

* Keep the Executive Director's files, documents, and shared drives organized and easy to find.
* Route documents for review, approval, and signature, and track them to completion.
* Serve as a link between the Executive Director's office and staff across departments, so information and requests get to the right place quickly.
* Partner with the Operations team on logistics for leadership meetings, board meetings, and events.
* Coordinate funder visits, site tours, and partner meetings, including scheduling, materials, and follow-up.
* Keep contact lists and records for funders and key partners up to date.

#### **Visitor Welcome, Main Phone Line & Mail**

* Greet all stakeholders who visit HOPE's main site, including participants, board members, funders, partners, and community members, and connect them to the right staff member or resource.
* Manage HOPE's main phone line: answer calls, review voicemail daily, and route messages to the right staff the same day.
* Manage mail for the main site: receive, sort, and distribute incoming mail and packages, and send outgoing mail.
* Prepare for visits from guests of the Executive Director and senior leadership, so each visit runs smoothly.
* Provide backup coverage at the front desk when needed, in coordination with the Operations team.

### **Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree, executive or administrative support experience, or both. Recent college graduates are encouraged to apply.
* Experience supporting a senior leader, or managing a busy calendar and inbox, is a plus.
* Strong judgment and discretion with confidential information, including board, personnel, and financial matters.
* A self-starting mindset, with a habit of anticipating needs and solving problems before they grow.
* Excellent written communication skills, including drafting professional emails and letters.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage competing priorities for several leaders.
* A warm, professional presence, in person and on the phone, with participants, board members, funders, and partners.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and/or Google Workspace, especially Excel or Sheets. Salesforce experience is a plus; we will train the right candidate.
* Commitment to HOPE's mission of advancing economic mobility through green careers.
* Spanish or another language spoken by HOPE participants is a plus.

**Work Environment**

* This position works on site at HOPE's main office five days per week; the work schedule may occasionally include early morning or evening hours for meetings and events.

**Marietta, GA**

In this customer-facing role, you will help customers keep their operations running by ensuring they have the right spare parts available when and where they are needed. You will combine customer relationship management, commercial ownership, performance management, and continuous improvement to help grow and strengthen our spare parts business.

* Strengthen distributor relationships to expand market presence and execution
* Become a trusted partner to customers through strategic planning and consistent engagement
* Contribute to category growth through promotions, pricing strategies, and market insights
* Collaborate cross-functionally to support forecasting, production planning, and account strategy

* Analyze historical and current purchase order data to project sales, assess profitability, and identify growth opportunities

* Maintain regular engagement with accounts to ensure customer needs are met or exceeded
* Execute promotional strategies and programs to drive volume and brand visibility
* Provide sales forecasts and input for production and demand planning
* Collaborate with executive leadership on pricing, promotions, quotes, and account strategies
* Resolve customer issues related to product, service, or sales execution
* Monitor competitive activity, market trends, and merchandising techniques
* Manage expenses in alignment with budgeted guidelines
* Demonstrate a growth-oriented, proactive sales approach focused on building and expanding strategic relationships
* Adhere to all company policies, procedures, and ethical standards while representing Inaba in a professional manner
* Perform additional duties as assigned

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Sales, or a related field
* 3–7 years of experience in sales within Pet Specialty, Food & Beverage, or adjacent CPG categories
* Experience calling on headquarters, regional offices, and/or managing distributor relationships
* Strong ability to analyze trends, data, and sales performance metrics
* Proficiency in creating compelling PowerPoint sales presentations
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and customer service skills
* Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple priorities
* Experience working cross-functionally with internal teams and external partners
* Ability to travel locally or regionally as needed, including time spent in the field
* Valid driver’s license with a safe driving record, in accordance with company policy
* Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite or related software

**Why Join Inaba Foods**

* Growing U.S. business with expanding distribution and increasing market presence
* Long-term stability and leadership from a well-established Japanese parent company
* Opportunity to manage meaningful accounts and influence growth strategy
* Collaborative, professional environment with a strong brand reputation

jobs.title: Account Manager - Wine & Spirits Macon and Central Georgia
jobs.description:
Description:

A Real Territory. Real Work. Real Upside.

This is a well-developed territory anchored in Central Georgia's core beverage corridor, stretching from Macon across the region's most active retail and restaurant markets through Warner Robins, Perry, and Dublin. The accounts are real, the portfolio is strong, and the market knows Eagle Rock.

What that means for the right person: you walk into credibility. What it doesn't mean: the work is done. Independent retail buyers and restaurant operators in this market have high expectations. Earning their business takes showing up prepared, knowing your products cold, and proving through consistency that you're worth their time. The rep who does that in this territory will build something worth keeping for a long time.

You'll also have something most reps don't: a Team Leader who built this territory over 20+ years, lives in the market, and brings regional oversight experience to everything you do. That knowledge is available to you. What you do with it is up to you.

Requirements:

**Who We’re Looking For**

The split is roughly 70% independent retail, 30% on-premise. This territory rewards someone who takes both seriously:

? **A Retail Seller Who Gets Independent Buyers -** Package stores and specialty wine shops are the backbone of this territory. You need to understand how independent owners think, what drives their decisions, and how to become the rep they call first.

? **Someone Who Earns Trust the Right Way -** Relationships in this market were built over years. You won't inherit them overnight. What you will have is a foundation and a name people recognize. Turning that into loyalty takes showing up, following through, and knowing your stuff.

? **A Self-Starter -** You own the route from day one. No one is going to build your schedule or tell you where to be. The reps who thrive here are the ones who treat the territory like it belongs to them, because it does.

? **Product Credible -** The buyers in this market know wine and spirits. You need to as well, or you need to be committed to getting there fast. Curiosity and preparation go a long way.

? **Coachable -** A 20-year veteran of this specific market is in your corner. The fastest path to growth in this role is knowing when to ask a question and being sharp enough to apply the answer.

? **Licensed & Road-Ready -** A valid Georgia driver's license and clean driving record are required. You'll be covering meaningful ground across Central Georgia every week.

**What You’ll Do**

* **Run the Territory -** Manage a full book of independent retail and on-premise accounts across Central Georgia. The route is yours. The results are yours.
* **Grow Your Retail Base -** Call on package stores, wine shops, and specialty retailers with consistency and preparation. Find gaps in distribution and fill them.
* **Work the On-Premise Accounts -** Maintain and grow relationships with the region's best restaurants. Secure placements, build by-the-glass programs, and show up as a resource, not just a vendor.
* **Merchandise and Execute -** Manage shelf placement, build displays, and bring promotional programs to life across your account base.
* **Prospect Aggressively -** A developed territory still has room to grow. Identify new accounts, open new doors, and expand Eagle Rock's footprint across the region.
* **Use Your Resources -** You have a Team Leader with 20+ years of market knowledge available to you. Use it. The reps who grow fastest here ask good questions and act on the answers.
* **Collaborate Internally -** Work with operations, logistics, and marketing to deliver clean execution from order to shelf.

**What You Get**

* **Commission-Based Compensation -** No ceiling. The territory has real volume and real upside. What you earn is a direct reflection of what you build.
* **Monthly Vehicle Allowance -** We cover your wheels so you can focus on the road ahead.
* **Full Benefits Package -** Medical, dental, vision, and 401(k).
* **20+ Years of Market Intelligence in Your Corner -** A Team Leader who built this territory from the ground up lives in the market and is available to you. That is a genuine competitive edge.
* **Ongoing Training & Development -** Product education, sales technique, and category expertise. We invest in making you better.
* **Exclusive Industry Access -** Producer visits, trade tastings, portfolio events, and direct access to some of the most respected names in wine and spirits.
* **A Culture That Wins -** We work hard, move fast, and celebrate the people who make it happen. Effort is recognized here and ambition has room to grow.

Physical Requirements

*This role involves hands-on account work including moving cases of wine and spirits, setting up displays, and driving between accounts daily. Must be able to lift up to 70 lbs. You'll work across a variety of environments including retail spaces, restaurants, coolers, and storage areas.*

Notice Regarding the Use of Artificial Intelligence in Application Review

**Notice of AI Use in Job Application Review**

As part of our commitment in creating a fair, efficient, and consistent hiring process we may use artificial intelligence (AI) to help our recruiting teams organize, summarize, and analyze information provided by candidates, including resumes, application responses, and other materials submitted during the application process.AI may be used to identify patterns, highlight relevant skills, and experience, and assist in comparing a candidate’s qualifications with the requirement of a specific role. These tools are to improve efficiency and consistency while supporting more informed hiring decisions, which will ultimately be made by the hiring team.

Asset Living is a third-party management firm and a proven partner in fostering thriving communities nationwide. Founded in 1986, Asset Living has decades of experience delivering exceptional value to our partners. Since the beginning, our undeniable passion has driven our organic growth from a small property management firm to one of the most trusted allies in real estate. At Asset Living, we wholeheartedly believe 'Together We Lead, Together We Succeed’. We empower each other to lead by example, collaborate, and evolve – inspired by our belief that we can continually improve as individuals and as an organization. Together, we create an environment where every voice is heard, every idea is valued, and every individual experiences opportunities to grow as our company grows. When you join Asset Living, you become part of a dynamic team that thrives on unity, unique talents, and a universal culture of winning.

jobs.title: Respiratory Sales Representative
jobs.description:
VieMed Healthcare is the largest independent specialized provider of non-invasive ventilation (NIV) in the US home respiratory health care industry. We specialize in treating the most challenging respiratory patients inside the home by pairing the best-in-class technology & equipment with the clinical care of a full-time Respiratory Therapist. We are always aiming to be the leading provider in post-acute in-home care with the implementation of palliative services.

Our Disease Management program has earned national attention, making us the number one independent ventilation provider in the United States. In recent random studies of our patient population, we have shown a 30-day COPD re-admission rate of 5.7% compared to the industry average of 20-22%\*. Over 93% of our patients share that they actually “Breathe Better” on our treatment program!

While our Respiratory Therapists provide the highest level of clinical care and support for our patients, our Sales Representatives work in conjunction with healthcare decision-makers to ensure a comfortable transition for the patient from the hospital to their home. This position combines front desk responsibilities with hands-on social media management, content creation, event support, and local community outreach. We’re looking for someone who can take ownership of projects, bring fresh ideas to the table, and help grow our brand.

Key Responsibilities

Studio Operations & Member Experience

* Greet members and manage class check-ins and check-outs.
* Respond to member calls, emails, voicemails, and inquiries through our booking portal.

* Maintain a clean, organized, and fully stocked reception and retail area.
* Monitor merchandise and studio supply inventory.
* Organize daily member milestone celebrations, birthdays, and special recognition.
* Complete miscellaneous administrative and studio tasks as needed.

Social Media Management & Content Creation

* Manage day-to-day posting on The Lagree Society’s social media accounts.
* Independently plan, create, schedule, and publish Instagram Reels, stories, and feed posts.
* Capture and edit engaging photo and video content during studio visits, classes, and events.
* Maintain a consistent content calendar aligned with upcoming promotions and studio activities.
* Write engaging captions and develop creative ideas that reflect our brand voice.
* Monitor comments, messages, and engagement, responding or escalating inquiries as appropriate.
* Stay current on social media trends and identify opportunities for growth.

Marketing & Community Engagement

* Assist with planning, promoting, and executing studio events, pop-ups, and special Society Sessions.
* Create and distribute promotional flyers, graphics, and marketing materials.
* Identify local partnership opportunities with businesses, wellness brands, and community organizations.
* Develop and execute creative marketing ideas to attract new clients and increase memberships.
* Support membership promotions, referral initiatives, and special campaigns.

Website & Digital Marketing

* Make routine website updates, including promotions, events, schedules, and studio information.
* Assist with basic SEO improvements.
* Create and distribute email newsletters and promotional communications.
* Ensure consistent branding across digital platforms and marketing materials.

Qualifications

* Experience managing social media accounts and creating short-form video content.

* Strong written communication and creative storytelling skills.
* Friendly, dependable, and comfortable interacting with members.

jobs.title: Temporary Partnerships Coordinator, Chicago Quantum Exchange
jobs.description:
**Department**

PME CQE Industry Partnerships

**About the Department**

The Pritzker School of Molecular Engineering (UChicago PME) is the first school in the nation dedicated to molecular engineering, and integrates science and engineering to address global challenges from the molecular level up. UChicago PME’s rigorous academic and research programs are enhanced through the University of Chicago’s unique partnership with Argonne and Fermi National Laboratories, and the broad excellence of scholarship and education on campus. In the next phase of growth as a School, PME will continue to expand its team of world-class faculty researchers and empower students from diverse backgrounds to collaborate with faculty in cutting-edge facilities. jobs.title: Customer Success Manager - Automotive
jobs.description:
**Customer Success Manager (Automotive SaaS)**
==============================================

**MOTO(acquire) | Chicago, IL (In Office, Downtown above Union Station) | Full Time | $65,000 to $90,000**

**About MOTO(acquire)**
-----------------------

MOTO(acquire) helps car dealerships buy more used vehicles directly from consumers. Our platform turns a dealer's website, customer database, service drive, and social media into acquisition channels:

* **MOTO(convert):** website trade tool with instant valuations, firm offer requests, and monthly value tracking
* **MOTO(retain):** sends past sales and service customers their vehicle's value every month
* **MOTO(drive):** service drive acquisition that uses DMS data and automated texts to find and buy cars already in the shop
* **MOTO(social):** gives every salesperson and creator their own link, with leads attributed in the CRM

We work with hundreds of dealerships across the country, from single rooftops to large dealer groups, and we're an approved vendor in the Stellantis dealer program. We're a small, fast-moving team, so your work will show up right away in dealer results and in how the company grows.

**The Role**
------------

We're hiring a Customer Success Manager to own the relationship with our dealer partners after the sale. You'll onboard new rooftops, make sure every dealer gets real value from MOTO(acquire), and catch problems before they turn into churn. You'll be the person dealers call when they need help, and the person who calls them first when the numbers say something is off.

You'll report directly to our CEO and work side by side with our sales team and engineers in our Chicago office. You'll also help us build the future of customer success at MOTO(acquire). We're building AI-assisted tools to monitor accounts, queue up outreach, and support dealers at scale, and we want you shaping how they work.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Own a book of dealer accounts and keep regular contact with every partner, including GMs, GSMs, used car managers, service directors, and BDC managers
* Build relationships with corporate leadership at dealer groups, including directors of used cars, fixed ops, digital, and operations, and keep MOTO(acquire) running smoothly across all of their rooftops
* Run onboarding and go-live calls for new rooftops: product walkthroughs, settings reviews, customer text reviews, testing, and launch
* Launch and support MOTO(drive) on the service drive, working with dealers to turn service customers into vehicle acquisitions
* Review dealer websites, lead flow, and performance data to spot problems early and suggest improvements
* Run regular performance reviews with dealers and dealer group leadership that show the vehicles, leads, and results MOTO(acquire) is delivering
* Track account health, usage, and customer contacts in HubSpot
* Help design and roll out AI-assisted customer success workflows, from automated account monitoring to AI-drafted dealer outreach
* Troubleshoot issues with dealers and work with our engineering team to get them fixed fast
* Find expansion opportunities (more rooftops, more products) and partner with sales to close them
* Feed what you hear from dealers back to product so we keep building the right things
* Represent MOTO(acquire) at NADA and on occasional visits to larger dealer groups

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

**Must haves**

* 2+ years in customer success, account management, or support at an automotive software company, OR 2+ years working in a car dealership
* Confident on the phone, on video calls, and in person with dealership leadership and dealer group executives
* Organized enough to manage a large book of accounts without anything slipping
* AI-minded: you already use tools like ChatGPT or Claude or Claude Code in your work, and you're excited to build smarter ways to support customers
* Comfortable with technology and quick to learn new tools
* A sense of urgency. Dealers move fast and expect the same from their vendors.
* Able to work in person at our downtown Chicago office five days a week
* Able to travel occasionally for NADA and dealer group visits

**Huge plus**

* Service acquisition experience: service drive equity mining, service-to-sales, or buying cars from service customers
* Experience in used car acquisition, appraisals, or trade-in tools
* Experience working with dealer groups or OEM programs
* Familiarity with dealership systems such as CDK, Reynolds & Reynolds, Dealertrack, Tekion, vAuto, or dealer CRMs
* Experience with HubSpot or another CRM
* Experience building automations, prompts, or workflows with AI tools

**Why MOTO(acquire)**
---------------------

* Report directly to the CEO and have real influence on the product and the company's direction
* Help build an AI-first customer success function from the ground up
* Work with hundreds of dealerships and some of the largest dealer groups in the country
* Unlimited PTO
* Downtown Chicago office above Union Station, easy to reach by Metra, Amtrak, and the CTA

**Compensation**
----------------

$65,000 to $90,000 base salary, depending on experience.

**Location**
------------

222 S. Riverside Plaza, Chicago, IL 60606. This is an in-person role, five days a week.

Oracle delivers one of the industry's most comprehensive portfolios across Data, AI, Analytics, Database, Applications, and Cloud Infrastructure. With Oracle's leadership in AI, autonomous database technology, cloud infrastructure, and enterprise applications, you'll help some of the world's most influential Professional Services organizations unlock the power of their data, accelerate innovation, and drive measurable business outcomes.

Join a team that is shaping the future of AI, data, and cloud transformation.

jobs.title: Sales Representative (Chicago)
jobs.description:
**What is Exoticca?**

Exoticca is a pioneering online travel agency that has revolutionized the conception, production, and e-commerce of long-distance dream trips. At the core of Exoticca's brand equity is the commitment to "creating life milestones." We believe in delivering best-value trips, exploring unique destinations, curating extraordinary travel experiences, and demonstrating genuine care for both our customers and the planet.  
  
We are a professional, dynamic, multicultural team in rapid international growth, seeking new partners to help us create the best and most forward-thinking travel company of our generation.

**What do we do?**

Our B2B Sales Team is responsible for developing and growing Exoticca's network of Travel Advisors and agency partners across North America. Through a combination of field sales, training, account activation and relationship management, the team helps Travel Advisors discover Exoticca, understand our product and ultimately grow their business with us.

**What will you do?**  
The Sales Representative (B2B) is a field-based sales role focused on developing and growing Exoticca's Tier 2 and Tier 3 agency accounts (Silver & Bronze) within an assigned territory. This is a hands-on, execution-focused position with a strong emphasis on in-person agency visits, account activation and high-frequency market coverage.

You will work closely with the Business Development Managers and the broader B2B Sales Team to ensure that our Silver and Bronze accounts receive regular commercial attention, product education and support, helping them increase their engagement and bookings with Exoticca.

**Your main responsibilities will include:**  

* Visit Travel Agencies regularly across the assigned territory, maintaining a consistent and high-frequency field presence.
* Manage and develop a portfolio primarily composed of Silver and Bronze account (Tier 2 & Tier 3) within Exoticca's Loyalty Program.
* Build strong relationships with Travel Advisors and agency teams, becoming their day-to-day commercial point of contact.
* Activate and grow existing accounts, helping Travel Advisors move from registration to first booking and from occasional to more frequent production.
* Identify opportunities to reactivate dormant and low-producing accounts.
* Educate Travel Advisors on Exoticca's destinations, products, promotions, booking tools and Loyalty Program.
* Conduct in-person product presentations, agency trainings and webinars.
* Identify potential new agency partners and support the acquisition and activation of new accounts.
* Promote group opportunities and identify potential group business within the assigned portfolio.
* Attend relevant trade shows, industry events, conferences and FAM trips when required.
* Maintain accurate and up-to-date information on account activity, visits and commercial opportunities in CRM.
* Work closely with Business Development Managers to identify accounts with significant growth potential that may require additional commercial support.
* Meet agreed activity and performance KPIs, including agency visits, account activation, booking activity and portfolio development.

The emphasis on frequent field coverage and a recurring visit pattern is intentional: the Sales Representative role is designed to provide more intensive market coverage than the more senior BDM structure.

 **Requirements**  

* 1–2 years of experience in sales, business development, account management on the travel industry.
* Experience within the travel industry is preferred, but we are also open to candidates with strong sales potential and a genuine interest in travel.
* Strong commercial mindset and enthusiasm for developing customer relationships.
* Comfortable spending a significant amount of time in the field visiting Trave Agencies.
* Self-motivated and comfortable managing a territory and daily visit schedule independently.
* Strong communication, interpersonal and presentation skills.
* Comfortable conducting small group presentations, product training and webinars.
* Organized and disciplined in managing follow-ups and CRM activity.
* Comfortable working in a dynamic, fast-changing and international environment.
* Willingness to learn, receive hands-on coaching and develop within the organization.
* Availability to travel regularly throughout the assigned territory and occasionally attend industry events and FAM trips.
* Fluency in Spanish is a plus.

  
**Benefits**  

* Competitive compensation package in line with job responsibilities and experience.
* Travel packages at reduced prices!
* English/Spanish lesson, bi-annual company parties.
* Referral bonus, if you bring people as talented as you.
* And last but not least, becoming part of a fun and motivated multicultural team at an agile and rapid growing organization!

Join Exoticca and play a pivotal role in creating life milestones through unforgettable travel experiences! This is your opportunity to shape the future of a dynamic and innovative travel brand on a global scale.

jobs.title: Assistant Project Manager
jobs.description:
Globetrotters Engineering is a full-service professional organization based in beautiful downtown Chicago, with remote work opportunities to work in downstate Illinois and Tampa, Florida area. We are proud to have served the public and private sectors since 1974, drawing upon highly qualified and experienced staff with diverse expertise to provide cost-effective, sustainable, and responsive services to our clients. Globetrotters is committed to planning, designing, constructing, and managing quality and sustainable infrastructure projects that play an integral role in the development and success of the communities we serve.

Globetrotters is a three-time honoree of the Best & Brightest Company to Work For® award (2024, 2025, 2026) and was also recognized as one of the Best Companies to Work for in Engineering in 2025. These distinguished awards recognize organizations that foster exceptional workplace cultures and demonstrate innovative business practices.

**Position Summary:**

Our onsite Program Management team in Chicago, IL is looking to add a driven and collaborative Assistant Project Manager - BHS in support of a multi-billion-dollar airport capital Redevelopment Program at O’Hare International Airport. This position allows for the opportunity to be a major contributor to the growth of one of the busiest airports in the world as part of the program management team.

Reporting to the Baggage Handling System (BHS) Project Manager, the Assistant Project Manager will support the planning, coordination, and execution of complex baggage handling system projects at O'Hare International Airport. This role serves as a key liaison between the Chicago Department of Aviation (CDA), client representatives, consultants, and the appointed Construction Manager at Risk (CMAR) to help ensure projects are delivered safely, on schedule, within budget, and in accordance with quality standards.

The Assistant Project Manager will support the Project Manager in stakeholder coordination, interface management, design and construction oversight, value engineering, risk management, problem resolution, reporting, and the preparation of presentations and project documentation. The role also provides day-to-day technical and administrative support throughout all phases of project delivery.

Responsibilities include assisting with the development of project plans, contract packages, procurement documents, and project execution strategies; providing technical support during design and construction; and coordinating project activities with internal and external stakeholders. The Assistant Project Manager will conduct regular site inspections to monitor construction progress, facilitate the Request for Information (RFI) and submittal review processes, assist in evaluating proposed design changes, and support the technical review of design and construction documents for compliance with project requirements.

Additional responsibilities include monitoring project schedules, tracking the CMAR's required reporting and contractual compliance, participating in project meetings and technical workshops, documenting action items, and supporting issue resolution. In the absence of the Project Manager, the Assistant Project Manager may serve as the acting Project Manager, providing leadership and ensuring continuity of project operations.

**We are looking for someone who has:**

* Bachelor's degree in Architecture, Engineering, Construction Management, or a related field, required.
* Minimum of five (5) years of experience as an Assistant Project Manager within an engineering, environmental, construction, or related professional services organization.
* Experience supporting the design and construction of projects with a minimum construction value of $100 million.
* Demonstrated project management experience throughout the design and construction phases of vertical building projects.
* Working knowledge of pre-design and pre-construction processes, building systems and technologies, contract administration, project delivery methods, team leadership, and client relationship management.
* Experience managing or supporting vertical design and construction projects.
* Ability to work onsite full-time at O'Hare International Airport as part of the Program Management Team.
* Experience with airline data systems, building management systems (BMS), and mechanical, electrical, plumbing, fire protection (MEPFP) systems.
* Experience utilizing Building Information Modeling (BIM) for project coordination and delivery.
* Experience working on aviation design or construction management projects.
* Experience with alternative project delivery methods, including Design-Build, CMAR, or Progressive Design-Build.
* Professional certification or licensure is preferred, including one or more of the following: Project Management Professional (PMP), Design-Build Institute of America (DBIA) Professional™, Professional Engineer (PE), or Registered Architect (RA).
* **Ability to work onsite full time at O’Hare International Airport with the program management team**

*All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.*

*The base salary range for this position is $105,000 – 145,000. Please note that the pay range provided is a good faith estimate for the position at the time of posting. Actual compensation within the range will be dependent on factors, including but not limited to, the candidate’s experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities.*

new_jobs.title: Men’s Social & Community Manager
new_jobs.description:
**About the Role**

  

The Men’s Social & Community Manager is the person who keeps Buck Mason's men's social channels running every day while standing up events to build community. You'll own the calendar and the posting, write the captions, answer the comments and DMs, run our creator program day to day, produce our events from guest list to teardown, and report back on what's working. The brand team sets the direction. You make it real on social and through our events.

  

It's an executional role with a high bar for taste for someone who’s product obsessed. Every caption, reply, creator pick, and guest list is a judgment call about what Buck Mason sounds and looks like, and we need someone who gets those calls right without a lot of back and forth. You'll work with the brand team and alongside Creative, Retail, Ecommerce, and Customer Experience.

  

### **What You'll Do**

**Social strategy and channel management**

* Own the men's social content calendar across all channels, aligned to product launches, campaigns, store openings, and seasonal moments.
* Help shape channel-by-channel strategy with the brand team: what each platform is for, what we post there, and how often. Then execute it.
* Publish daily, manage the queue, and keep every post on-brand in tone, typography, and image quality.
* Stay on top of platform changes and emerging formats, and propose tests worth running.

**Content and voice**

* Write captions, scripts, replies, and copy in the Buck Mason voice
* Partner with Creative on social-first photo and video, contributing to briefs and shot lists; capture content yourself when the moment calls for it.
* Build repeatable series and formats that give the men's feed a point of view.

**Community**

* Respond to comments and DMs daily in the brand voice, and route product and order issues to Customer Experience with context.
* Track sentiment, recurring questions, and product feedback, and share what you hear with Design, Retail, and Ecommerce weekly.

**Events**

* Produce Buck Mason's men's events end to end.
* Curate the invite list. Know who should be in the room, from loyal customers and local tastemakers to creators and press, and get them there.
* Build the vibe: concept, venue, music, food and drink, run of show, and the details that make it feel like us and not like a brand event.
* Own the logistics: budget, vendors, staffing, RSVPs, and day-of production, so everything goes off without a hitch.
* Capture it for social use in coordination with the Creative team and our event photographer.

**Partnerships and influencers**

* Source and manage day-to-day relationships with creators, stylists, and tastemakers whose audiences match ours: outreach, gifting, scheduling, and content review, with support from the brand team on contracts and budget.
* Coordinate with Paid Media on which organic content and creator assets should be amplified.

**Measurement**

* Own weekly social reporting: reach, engagement, follower growth, community health, and traffic attributed to social.
* Contribute to the monthly brand marketing readout with clear takeaways on what's working, and adjust the calendar accordingly.
* Work toward quarterly goals set with the brand team.

### **What You'll Bring**

* 2–4 years running or supporting social and community for a consumer brand, ideally in menswear, lifestyle, or DTC retail.
* Examples of accounts you've worked on and content you've made, with results you can speak to.
* Excellent writing. You can land a caption in one line and a reply in a sentence, and you know when to say nothing.
* A sharp eye for photography, typography, and taste that fits a brand built on restraint.
* Fluency in Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and Pinterest, including native creation tools, and working knowledge of social management and listening platforms (e.g. Sprout, Later, Dash Hudson).
* Comfort with data: you can read a dashboard, pull a weekly report, and say in plain terms what the numbers mean.
* Some experience working with creators or influencer partnerships.
* Event experience. You've produced or coordinated brand events, you're calm on the day, and you sweat the details nobody notices until they're wrong.
* Organized and reliable. You can run a calendar, juggle a product launch and a store opening in the same week, and keep the account fed.
* A real interest in menswear: how clothes are made, how they fit, and the men who wear them. You know the difference between a Pima tee and a slub, and you have opinions on both.
* Experience in menswear: you understand the customer face to face.
* Basic photo and video editing skills (CapCut, Premiere, Lightroom).

### **Logistics**

* Reports to: VP of Digital
* Location: Buck Mason HQ, Los Angeles — onsite, 5 days/week
* Type: Full-time, exempt

### **Benefits**

Health/Dental/Vision:

* We’ve got you covered – Buck Mason takes care of 80% of the monthly cost for employee-only plans. That 20% not covered gets deducted from your bi-weekly paycheck.
* Dependents – Buck Mason takes care of 50% of the monthly cost and 50% comes out of  
  your bi-weekly paycheck.
* We offer a wide range of PPO and HMO options through Anthem, with Vision and Dental plans  
  through Principal.  
  Plus, we’ve got HSA and FSA options to keep things flexible.
* 401k:  
  We’re all about planning for the future. Buck Mason matches 100% of your first 3% contribution,  
  and 50% of the next 2%. So you get a max match of 4% from us if you chip in 5%. Not too shabby, right?

Other Perks:

* We offer an $80 cell-phone reimbursement for your monthly phone plan (excluding the device)so you can make those important calls on us.
* Every month, you can ask us for a $50 wellness reimbursement. Use it for gym memberships,fitness classes, or mental health expenses – it’s up to you.
* Maternity Leave – 12 weeks of paid leave
* No probationary period to be eligible, State funds first (disability, Paid Family Leave, etc.) Buck Mason covers the remain

new_jobs.title: Operations Associate, Part Time - South Coast Plaza
new_jobs.description:
**Who we are:**

Since 2009, we've been on a mission to bring sustainable fashion to everyone. Named one of **Fast Company's Brands That Matter**and winning a **Best Carbon Footprint**award, we have big goals like being **Climate Positive by 2025**, **Circular by 2030**, and pushing the whole industry forward along the way.Our work has gotten love in **Drapers**and **Sourcing Journal**, and**TIME**wrote about how great our CEO, Hali Borenstein, is. Basically, we're saving the Earth and looking damn good doing it.

We're a global brand with 50+ stores (and counting) around the world, and our own**sustainable factory in LA**. We innovate across categories like **accessories**, **swimwear**, and **sleepwear**, and we reach millions of people with campaigns like **this**,**this** and **this**.

None of this work is possible without the incredible people behind it. We're a mission-based company that invests in an inclusive culture, so we can innovate together and ensure everyone has the space to grow, thrive, and belong.

And starting right now, we want to do all that **with you.**

**Work Location/ Schedule:**

* Available to work a minimum of 20 hours per week,
* Available to work a minimum of 3 days per week, weekends included.
* Able to work flexible schedule (days, nights, weekends, & holidays if required to meet the needs of the business).

**Operations Associate:**

As an operations associate at Reformation, your primary role will be to provide support in daily operations, standardize processes in store, merchandising, and maintaining a clean and organized store environment. You will support both the store's goals and your responsibilities will include assisting with inventory control supporting the store's success , while creating a positive shopping experience.

**What You'll Do:**

* Support the operational efforts required to achieve store goals.
* Maintain seamless store operational procedures.
* Consistently use and understand processes and procedures to track in store inventory accurately.
* Track, receive and process all inbound inventory shipments.
* Complete inventory related tasks as necessary with an elevated attention to detail, including inbound and outbound store transfers, shipment, and omni channel order processing.
* Complete shipment processing - receiving, hanging, steaming, tagging (when applicable) and organizing in the back of house.
* Support the process of completing markdowns when applicable.
* Submit facilities tickets to ensure maintenance, presentation and organization.
* Organize store supplies.
* Ensure the back of house reflects the brand and concept standards at all times.
* Prepare and deliver all customer fitting rooms quickly and accurately.
* Prepare and support all customer purchases in alignment with brand standards, preparing, folding and bagging products.
* Replenish the sales floor when products are sold to ensure visual presentations and inventory levels meet brand standards at all times.
* Support execution of visual merchandising tasks as new products are received, including adjusting visual merchandising when products are sold out or sold through.
* Execute visual displays and mannequins when directed.
* Receive extraordinary customer experience feedback and scoring on service evaluation.
* Contribute to Loss Prevention in all areas of the business.
* Uphold time and attendance policy.
* Bring an ambitious and passionate attitude to work daily.
* Help ensure that the store environment is inspiring and our product is easily accessible.
* Understand the core values and culture of Reformation and reflect these in all efforts.
* Maintain and uphold a professional, healthy, and productive work environment.

**What You'll Bring:**

* 1+ years relevant experience in a fastpaced, creative service environment.
* Familiarity with the user functionality of desktop, mobile, tablet and digital technologies.
* Experience working with a sales or retail organization and/or operationally intensive business.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced setting.
* Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to interact effectively with diverse personalities.
* Driven approach to take on new challenges with the self-motivation for your work and career.

**Compensation:**

At Reformation, we believe in transparency and equity when it comes to compensation. For this role, the anticipated base **hourly range is $16 – $25 per hour**, depending on a variety of factors, including but not limited to relevant experience, skills, qualifications, and internal compensation equity.

Please note that compensation decisions are made thoughtfully and may vary from the listed range to reflect individual circumstances and evolving business needs. Our total rewards package also includes benefits, perks, and opportunities for growth that contribute to overall compensation.

**Benefits & Perks:**

* Eligible employees get employer-sponsored private medical, dental, and vision insurance, as well as commuter benefits to help support your travel to and from work.
* We offer competitive paid time off policies including vacation, sick leave, and company holidays for eligible employees.
* We offer retirement planning support for eligible employees, including the option to invest in Environmental Social Governance-aligned (fancy way to say sustainable) funds.
* We're a mission-based company with offices in LA, NYC and London, as well as a global retail team, which means you'll get to collaborate with people all around the world.
* You'll get access to fertility care support through **Carrot**, and up to a $5,000 USD reimbursement for related fertility expenses after 1 year of employment.
* We care about the causes our employees care about so we donate to community efforts on a yearly basis.
* We offer a clothing discount, culture events (like our annual Ref Values week and Volunteer Time Off), you know, all the meaningful and fun stuff!

***Reformation is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.

new_jobs.title: Marketing Operations Associate, Direct Marketing
new_jobs.description:
StubHub is on a mission to redefine the live event experience on a global scale. Whether someone is looking to attend their first event or their hundredth, we're here to delight them all the way from the moment they start looking for a ticket until they step through the gate. The same goes for our sellers. From fans selling a single ticket to the promoters of a worldwide stadium tour, we want StubHub to be the safest, most convenient way to offer a ticket to the millions of fans who browse our platform around the world.

From a team advancing to the playoffs to a major artist announcing a world tour, some of StubHub's most impactful marketing moments require quick decisions, sharp execution, and the ability to act at scale.

We're looking for a **Marketing Operations Associate** to help capitalize on these exciting moments and deliver timely, relevant email and push campaigns that drive fan engagement and business impact.

In this role, you'll own the planning, prioritization, and execution of high-impact event campaigns across sports, music, theater, and comedy. You'll determine which opportunities to act on leveraging insight tooling and coordinate campaigns from concept through launch, either independently or leading design and engineering teammates. You'll balance a planned marketing calendar with real-time opportunities, where speed and sound judgment can make a meaningful difference.

Beyond campaign execution, you'll help shape how our Direct Marketing team operates at scale. You'll identify opportunities to streamline workflows, improve campaign quality, and reduce manual effort, partnering with Product, Data, and Engineering to develop tools and automation that make our marketing more efficient and effective.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, brings strong operational judgment and attention to detail, and is excited to both execute great campaigns and build better ways of working. Your impact will be measured not just by the campaigns you launch, but by how you help automate and scale campaign orchestration workflows.

**Location**: Hybrid (3 days in office/2 days remote) – New York, NY or Century City, CA or Aliso Viejo, CA

**What You'll Do:**

**Campaign Strategy & Execution**

* Own the end-to-end execution of email and push campaigns, from opportunity assessment and prioritization through briefing, production, QA, launch, and performance review.
* Manage the marketing calendar, balancing planned campaigns around major events with high-value opportunities that emerge in real time.
* Identify and prioritize campaign opportunities using event signals, audience relevance, business impact, and timing.
* Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to coordinate campaign requests, manage dependencies, and ensure timely, high-quality execution.

**Operational Excellence & Scale**

* Improve campaign workflows, templates, QA processes, and documentation to increase execution speed, consistency, and quality.
* Identify repetitive manual tasks and collaborate with Product, Data, and Engineering to develop existing and new scalable tooling and automation.
* Help transition the team to new processes and tooling. Gather feedback to improve solutions and ensure adoption.

**Measurement & Optimization**

* Monitor campaign performance and identify opportunities to improve targeting, creative, timing, and execution.
* Partner with the team to propose and execute experiments to improve campaign effectiveness and inform future strategy.

**What You've Done:**

* 3+ years of experience in marketing operations, campaign management, program management, or a related field.
* Experience managing complex campaign calendars, operational workflows, or cross-functional programs in fast-paced environments.
* Strong project management skills, with the ability to coordinate multiple campaigns, stakeholders, deadlines, and dependencies simultaneously.
* Exceptional attention to detail and operational rigor, particularly around campaign setup, quality assurance, and execution.
* Strong prioritization and analytical judgment, with the ability to evaluate opportunities based on business impact, customer relevance, and urgency.
* Comfort navigating ambiguity, responding to time-sensitive opportunities, and balancing speed with quality.
* Clear communication skills and a collaborative approach to solving cross-functional challenges.
* A strong sense of ownership and bias for action; the ideal candidate is always seeking continuous improvement and measurable business impact.
* Comfort working with performance data and using metrics to inform decisions.

**Nice to Have:**

* Experience executing email, push, SMS, or other CRM campaigns.
* Background in consumer marketplaces, ecommerce, ticketing, entertainment, or other high-velocity consumer businesses.
* Familiarity with audience segmentation, personalization, A/B testing, and campaign performance measurement.
* Experience improving campaign workflows through automation, tooling, or process design.
* Working knowledge of SQL or analytics tools.

**Why this role matters:**

  

Direct marketing is one of StubHub's most powerful levers for reaching fans during high-intent moments. Many of the most valuable event opportunities are time-sensitive: playoff advancement, finals matchups, major tours, rivalry games, onsales, inventory changes, and other marquee moments where speed and relevance matter.

Today, many of these campaigns require significant manual coordination, which limits the number of opportunities the team can act on and creates tradeoffs between campaign volume, speed, and quality. This role will increase the team's capacity to execute more high-impact campaigns while building the operating foundation needed to scale.

**Success in this role will mean:**

* More high-priority event campaigns launched on time.
* Faster turnaround from opportunity identification to campaign send.
* Higher-quality execution with few

new_jobs.description:
**About Us**
------------

Foundry Robotics is building an AI-native robotics manufacturing company focused on deploying advanced assembly and production capability for leading robotics companies and national-security-critical hardware. Basically, we're building robots that build robots.  
  
We are reimagining manufacturing through advanced robotics. Our mission is to rebuild the American manufacturing industry as an AI-first, assembly-focused, dual-use contract manufacturer. We aim to empower manufacturers with intelligent, efficient, and adaptable robotic systems that redefine productivity and quality. As a senior leader on our manufacturing team, you will have a direct and significant impact on our product, culture, and ultimate success. This role is 100% in-person at our office in Emeryville, CA.

**The Role**
------------

Our conferences and events are currently run by whoever has capacity. That has worked, and it has cost us: no one owns the calendar, no one owns the booth, and no one can say what any of it returned. This role takes all of it.

You will own the event program end to end — which shows we attend, what we bring, who we meet, and what came of it. You will run the logistics yourself, and you will be the person who can answer "was that show worth it?" with numbers rather than impressions.

This is a junior role with real surface area. When the event calendar is quiet, you will spend your time on social and content alongside our Social Media & Brand Voice Lead.

This is an on-site role in Emeryville. Events also mean travel flexibility.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* **Own the calendar.** Build and maintain the annual event plan — trade shows, conferences, customer dinners, recruiting events. Make the case for each one before we commit, not after.
* **Own the environment**. Plan and create the booth design, the giveaways and the experience visitors have and the impression they leave with of the Foundry brand, product and company.
* **Run the events.** Manage all aspects of the event from end to end and assign roles as needed (and available). Own the booth build and stocking, shipping and logistics, badges, hotels, travel, collateral, demo hardware, on-site setup and teardown. You are the one who knows where the crate is.
* **Own the numbers.** Define what a show is supposed to return before we go. Track spend, leads captured, meetings booked, pipeline influenced. Publish a readout within a week of every event, including the ones that did not work.
* **Run the follow-up.** Get leads out of the badge scanner and into the hands of the people who can act on them, with context, within 48 hours.
* **Prep the team.** Brief whoever is staffing the booth — talk track, target accounts, who to find, what to say. Make sure engineers who have never worked a show know what good looks like.
* **Support social and content.** Capture the shop floor and the show floor: photos, video, short posts. Draft and schedule content, and keep the content calendar honest.
* **Manage vendors and budget.** Contracts, deadlines, invoices, deposits. Keep the event budget current and flag overruns early.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

Founder mentality: We love people who build like it's their own company. You move fast, take ownership, and find a way through when the path isn't obvious. You have the drive to make big things happen and the judgment to take smart risks along the way. If you prefer a clearly defined lane, a predictable pace, and all the answers before you start, there's nothing wrong with that—but Foundry might not be the right fit.

* 1–3 years running events, field marketing. Conference, agency, hospitality, or ops backgrounds all count.
* Evidence you have shipped something physical to a deadline and had it arrive working.
* Comfort with a spreadsheet: budgets, lead counts, cost per meeting. You should want to know the number, not be handed it.
* Clear, quick writing. Booth copy, a one-pager, a follow-up email, a post.
* Willingness to travel and to work the long day that a show floor actually is.
* A bias toward doing it yourself. We are small; there is no events team behind you yet.

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* Experience at a hardware, robotics, manufacturing, or defense company.
* Having run a booth at a large industrial or defense trade show.
* CRM fluency (HubSpot, Salesforce) and lead routing.
* Photo, video, or social editing skills.

We care more about what you have run than where you ran it. If you have organized something ambitious outside of a job, tell us about it.

**Why Join Us?**
----------------

This is one of the only places where world-class manufacturing operators, mechanical engineers, robotics researchers, and software engineers sit in the same room — building production systems together.

We are committed to being deeply embedded in the U.S. industrial base. Our focus is simple: build adaptive robotic assembly systems that make American manufacturing scalable, resilient, and competitive again.

If you want to run a mature, well-defined commercial org, this may not be the role.

If you want to build the commercial engine that brings AI-driven manufacturing to every industrial and energy customer in America — this is it.

The base salary range for this full-time position in the location of Emeryville, CA is:

**$90,000—$150,000 USD**

Compensation packages at Foundry Robotics for eligible roles include base salary, equity, and benefits. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for the position, determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, interview performance, and relevant education or training. Foundry Robotics employees in eligible roles are also granted equity based compensation, subject to Board of Director approval. You'll also receive benefits including, but not limited to: Comprehensive health

**Key Account Manager – Pet Specialty**  
**Location:** Atlanta, GA (In-Office)  
**Reports to:** Sr. Sales Manager  
**Category Focus:** Pet Specialty Channel  
  
**About Inaba Foods (USA) Inc.**  
Inaba Foods is a manufacturer of premium pet food, treats, toppers, and complements, deeply rooted in a family tradition of excellence that spans generations. Since 1958, pet parents have trusted Inaba to deliver products that are human-grade, nutrient-rich, and designed to bring joy to pets.  
  
Today, Inaba is the most popular brand of premium cat and dog dinners and treats in Japan, with growing distribution throughout the United States and globally. Inaba Foods (USA) Inc. continues to expand its footprint, invest in talent, and build long-term partnerships across the pet industry, supported by the stability and vision of our Japanese parent company.  
  
**Position Summary**  
Inaba Foods (USA) Inc. is seeking a Key Account Manager – Pet to develop and manage strategic relationships at the headquarters and regional level with national and regional retailers, as well as distributors, within the Pet Specialty channel. This role is responsible for driving growth, expanding distribution, and strengthening long-term partnerships while collaborating closely with internal teams to execute sales strategies.  
  
This is a full-time, in-office position based in Atlanta, GA, as required by company leadership.  
  
**What Success Looks Like in This Role**

* Grow distribution and sales volume within assigned Pet Specialty accounts
* Strengthen distributor relationships to expand market presence and execution
* Become a trusted partner to customers through strategic planning and consistent engagement
* Contribute to category growth through promotions, pricing strategies, and market insights
* Collaborate cross-functionally to support forecasting, production planning, and account strategy

**Key Responsibilities**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned customers and distributors, nurturing existing business and driving incremental growth
* Analyze historical and current purchase order data to project sales, assess profitability, and identify growth opportunities
* Lead and participate in customer business reviews and market presentations
* Maintain regular engagement with accounts to ensure customer needs are met or exceeded
* Execute promotional strategies and programs to drive volume and brand visibility
* Provide sales forecasts and input for production and demand planning
* Collaborate with executive leadership on pricing, promotions, quotes, and account strategies
* Resolve customer issues related to product, service, or sales execution
* Monitor competitive activity, market trends, and merchandising techniques
* Manage expenses in alignment with budgeted guidelines
* Demonstrate a growth-oriented, proactive sales approach focused on building and expanding strategic relationships
* Adhere to all company policies, procedures, and ethical standards while representing Inaba in a professional manner
* Perform additional duties as assigned

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Sales, or a related field
* 3–7 years of experience in sales within Pet Specialty, Food & Beverage, or adjacent CPG categories
* Experience calling on headquarters, regional offices, and/or managing distributor relationships
* Strong ability to analyze trends, data, and sales performance metrics
* Proficiency in creating compelling PowerPoint sales presentations
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and customer service skills
* Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple priorities
* Experience working cross-functionally with internal teams and external partners
* Ability to travel locally or regionally as needed, including time spent in the field
* Valid driver’s license with a safe driving record, in accordance with company policy
* Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite or related software

**Why Join Inaba Foods**

* Growing U.S. business with expanding distribution and increasing market presence
* Long-term stability and leadership from a well-established Japanese parent company
* Opportunity to manage meaningful accounts and influence growth strategy
* Collaborative, professional environment with a strong brand reputation

Inaba Foods is an Equal Opportunity Employer and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment laws, including California’s Fair Employment and Housing Act.

**Job Title:** Property Content Coordinator

**Reports To:** Senior Property Marketing Manager

**About Cross Street:**

Cross Street is a Chicago-based real estate services firm built on a strong foundation of property operations and client service. We bring together institutional-level experience with an entrepreneurial mindset to support owners and investors across residential portfolios.

From property management to brokerage and advisory, our team takes a hands-on, accountable approach focused on long-term value for both our clients and the residents who call these community’s home.

**Job Overview:**

The Property Content Coordinator brings Cross Street properties to life through hands-on content creation, community outreach, events, and day-to-day marketing execution. This active, property-facing role regularly spends time on-site and in surrounding neighborhoods—capturing photos and videos, connecting with local businesses and community partners, supporting events, and collaborating with leasing teams.

The Coordinator supports leasing momentum during lease-up and ongoing occupancy by ensuring each property has timely, engaging content and consistent marketing support throughout its lifecycle. From grand openings and first move-ins to new amenities and hard-to-lease floor plans, the Coordinator identifies opportunities, captures compelling content, and turns property moments into creative marketing that supports leasing goals.

Working closely with the Senior Property Marketing Manager and broader marketing team, the Coordinator also maintains asset libraries and content calendars, coordinates photography and videography vendors, and tracks marketing projects, approvals, and deliverables.

As Cross Street’s portfolio grows, this role helps deliver consistent marketing support across more properties, allowing marketing leadership to focus on strategy, client satisfaction, and broader campaign priorities.

Events & Marketing Activations

Vendor & Marketing Project Coordination

* Coordinate marketing vendors and partners, including photographers, videographers, event vendors, printers, and promotional-product suppliers.

* Coordinate Move-In Gift selection, including vendor recommendations, mockups, quotes, ordering, and delivery.
* Support vendor coordination and marketing budget tracking by collecting quotes, coordinating invoice processing with vendors, accounting, and the Senior Property Marketing Manager, and maintaining organized records of costs, approvals, and expenses for marketing initiatives, collateral, events, and other assigned projects
* Support marketing budget tracking by collecting quotes, coordinating invoice processing with vendors and accounting, and maintaining cost, approval, and expense records.

Lease-Up & Pre-Leasing Support

* Support lease-up marketing execution, including preparation of marketing and leasing materials, collateral, and prospect-facing assets.
* Support the preparation of model units, temporary leasing environments, displays, and other pre-leasing marketing needs. o Support property openings, model-unit launches, amenity launches, and other lease-up marketing initiatives.

Job description

At Qualtrics, we create software the world’s best brands use to deliver exceptional frontline experiences, build high-performing teams, and design products people love. But we are more than a platform—we are the creators and stewards of the Experience Management category serving over 18K clients globally. Building a category takes grit, determination, and a disdain for convention—but most of all it requires close-knit, high-functioning teams with an unwavering dedication to serving our customers.
  
  
When you join one of our teams, you’ll be part of a nimble group that’s empowered to set aggressive goals and move fast to achieve them. Strategic risks are encouraged and complex problems are solved together, by passing the microphone and iterating until the best solution comes to light. You won’t have to look to find growth opportunities—ready or not, they’ll find you. From retail to government to healthcare, we’re on a mission to bring humanity, connection, and empathy back to business. Join over 5,000 people across the globe who think that’s work worth doing.

**Account Manager**

As a Sr Account Manager on our Safety Delivery Team, you will play a central role in delivering exceptional support and implementation services to healthcare clients. You will serve as a primary client advocate, managing support requests, assisting with implementations, and leveraging deep safety product knowledge to troubleshoot platform issues and advise healthcare organizations on best practices. A key responsibility includes leading client implementations into our Patient Safety Organization (PSO), ensuring technical integrations and operational requirements are fully achieved. If you are passionate about technology-driven healthcare transformation, driving user adoption, and improving patient safety outcomes, this role is for you.

  

**How You’ll Find Success**

* **Detail & Deadline Management:** Comfortably manages multiple simultaneous projects, client accounts, and deadlines with strong organizational skills.
  

  

**How You’ll Grow**

* Expand your expertise in healthcare SaaS platforms, patient safety protocols, incident reporting workflows, and PSO compliance framework operations.

* Enhance your client enablement and instructional design skills by developing client-facing training programs and best-practice documentation.

**Things You’ll Do**

* **Manage Client Support & Escalations:** Efficiently resolve client support tickets for safety platforms and partner with technical teams on escalated issues.

* **Lead PSO Implementations:** Serve as the primary point of contact for onboarding clients into the Patient Safety Organization (PSO), ensuring complete alignment with system integrations and compliance standards.

* **Advise on Safety Workflows:** Recommend platform features and workflows that align with client safety goals, incident reporting needs, and compliance standards.
  

  

**What We’re Looking For On Your Resume**

* **3+ years** of client-facing experience in customer service, healthcare, or project management (ideally within Healthcare SaaS or digital health technology).

**What You Should Know About This Team**

**Our Team’s Favorite Perks and Benefits**
